[Axios recently declared that Democrats have entered their "thirst trap era."](https://substack.com/redirect/614715fe-2d26-4ef3-bc1d-25052f9cd934?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The party's social media accounts have been featuring Jon Ossoff, Zohran Mamdani, Abdul El-Sayed in his fitted black T-shirts, and Barack Obama with a little gray in his hair. AOC and Michelle Obama have received similar treatment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a081b96-899b-4bd1-ad2b-6dc35aa0d2d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[https://www.axios.com/2026/08/18/democrats-social-media-ossoff-el-sayed](https://substack.com/redirect/614715fe-2d26-4ef3-bc1d-25052f9cd934?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But let's be honest. Thirst trap politics is not a Democratic invention. Republicans have been doing this too. In fact, politicians around the world have been using their looks, clothing, bodies, fitness, and sexuality for attention long before anyone knew what a thirst trap was.
What has changed is the intent, the delivery system, and who controls the picture.
A politician being attractive is not automatically a thirst trap. A politician being sexualized by the media is not the same as a politician intentionally posting sexualized content. There are levels to this, and if we are going to talk about thirst trap politics, we should at least define what we are talking about.
Merriam-Webster defines a [thirst trap](https://substack.com/redirect/b916a22d-1c57-4564-b132-885ccfc7ab6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a photograph or video shared for the purpose of attracting attention or desire.
The important word is purpose.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dBwWyTwo9sMQkszw6tFXHZ0VrULIuf6rLLnVOIyh4rU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212423615)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dBwWyTwo9sMQkszw6tFXHZ0VrULIuf6rLLnVOIyh4rU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212423615)
* * *
## Level One: You Are Hot and Other People Notice
**The first level** is not really thirst trapping at all. It is simply being an attractive person in public life and having the media, paparazzi, or internet sexualize you.
John F. Kennedy would be the historical example. He was young, attractive, athletic, wealthy, and surrounded by an entire political mythology built around youth, vigor, and Camelot. Pictures of him sailing, swimming, or sitting shirtless on a boat became part of his public image regardless of the purpose of those pictures .
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7d6df817-a95c-48cb-9797-70712e5b9b0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President John F. Kennedy
Barack Obama experienced the modern version of that in 2008. While he was vacationing in Hawaii after the election, [paparazzi positioned themselves on the beach with long lenses and photographed him shirtless](https://substack.com/redirect/4664eda3-34c2-449e-b015-0034beff8763?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Obama was not standing there taking a mirror selfie and asking America what it thought of his abs. He was existing on a beach while attractive, and the media did the rest.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da143092-ba59-4cfa-a6fb-938102f29065?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Barack Obama
The same thing happens to women, although usually with a much nastier double standard.
AOC can wear a dress, put on red lipstick, or show up at an event looking good, and the internet immediately turns her into either a sex symbol or the subject of some weird conservative fantasy. There have even been [digitally altered pictures created to make her clothing look more revealing](https://substack.com/redirect/70ddf5ea-40f3-4525-befd-7140d41d28d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Former New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern once sat for an interview in which the male interviewer described her as young and attractive, then started asking about when her child was conceived. The interview was [widely criticized as sexist and creepy](https://substack.com/redirect/9305be5e-0cb5-4e09-be72-9b11e12a7a33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7839ff39-005f-4694-affc-519d441a84af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Former New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern
Former Finnish Prime Minister Sanna Marin was sexualized constantly because she was young, attractive, and liked to go out with her friends. Private videos of her dancing were leaked, and suddenly the world was debating whether a prime minister was allowed to party.
**That is not thirst trapping.**
That is other people seeing an attractive politician and deciding to thirst over them. The politician may benefit from the attention, but they did not create or release the image.
There is a difference between setting a trap and having the internet decide that you are the trap.
* * *
## Level Two: The Political Flex
**The second level is the flex.**
This is when politicians intentionally display their bodies, athleticism, or physical conditioning, but the primary message is supposed to be health, strength, vitality, discipline, or power.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is a perfect example.
Kennedy is now 72 years old, is obviously in very good shape, and clearly wants everyone to know it. He posts workout videos. He does pull-ups in jeans. Earlier this year, he and Kid Rock released a [90-second video in which they exercised, flexed shirtless, played pickleball, took a cold plunge, and drank whole milk](https://substack.com/redirect/ba5ed192-8a2c-4908-961a-ea94b9b1ac15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/38a21530-7137-4a4d-81c0-836724a46255?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
The stated message was to get active and eat real food. It fit directly into Kennedy's Make America Healthy Again brand.
But come on, man.
RFK Jr. knows he looks good for 72. He knows the video will get attention. He knows people will talk about his body. That is part of the message. His physical condition is presented as evidence that his health philosophy works.
It is a flex, but it is a political flex.
Vladimir Putin used the same idea differently. His shirtless horseback pictures were not primarily about making people want to get thirsty. They were about projecting masculinity, dominance, strength, and control. The picture became an extension of the political brand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/06711bcd-b663-41ac-932b-c23fc2aaf3f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Vladimir Putin
American politicians have done softer versions of this for decades. Bill Clinton went jogging. George W. Bush was photographed exercising and clearing brush. Pete Buttigieg goes running. Politicians throw baseballs, shoot baskets, ride bicycles, lift weights, and perform whatever physical activity makes them look healthy enough to survive four years in office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2497c943-8a51-4d7b-a42c-9f1b6032c5ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bill Clinton
Sometimes the flex is connected to policy. Sometimes it is supposed to communicate strength.
It is image-conscious, and it can be intentionally attractive, but it is not a thirst trap.
* * *
## Level Three: I Know I Look Good, and I Know What You Will Do With This
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dBwWyTwo9sMQkszw6tFXHZ0VrULIuf6rLLnVOIyh4rU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212423615)
**The third level** is where plausible deniability tapers off.
The politician is not necessarily posting an openly thirsty picture, but they know what the clothing, camera angle, or presentation will do. They know the internet will sexualize it, and they are counting on everybody else to complete the transaction.
Abdul El-Sayed's campaign uniform is a good current example.
El-Sayed campaigned across Michigan in a fitted black V-neck T-shirt and jeans. It was a simple look, but it also made sure you noticed that he goes to the gym. Even Fox News repeatedly called him "gym boy," talked about his pecs, and asked his Republican opponent whether he planned to compete with El-Sayed's tight shirts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3c05a918-ecbf-4cd9-9dbd-c111e7cb396b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Abdul El-Sayed
El-Sayed did not take his shirt off. He did not release a bikini calendar. He wore a fitted shirt that supported his anti-establishment, ready-to-fight image and also happened to show his arms.
**He knew.**
That does not make it a full thirst trap. It makes it a very deliberate flex that allows everyone else to do the thirst trapping for him.
Former Republican Congressman Aaron Schock took it further. In 2011, Schock appeared shirtless on the cover of _Men 's Health_, where he was promoted as ["America's Fittest Congressman."](https://substack.com/redirect/06adc5f1-0518-48f3-bbaf-612839076303?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3a7616f0-d681-4d53-bc6c-57dd0cf0cb9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Former Republican Congressman Aaron Schock
The official explanation was health. Schock was promoting fitness and talking about the cost of diabetes, heart disease, and other preventable conditions.
Okay.
He was also a 29-year-old congressman with a six-pack, standing shirtless on a national magazine cover. He knew exactly what kind of attention that would create. The health campaign made the picture politically defensible, but the abs did the marketing.
Lauren Boebert sits somewhere around this category too. A bikini photo showing her large side tattoo was recirculated in 2024 by Ginger Gaetz, who praised "confident, healthy, patriotic women." It was unclear when the original picture was taken, and [Boebert was not the person who republished it](https://substack.com/redirect/dd0607ea-9477-4a4b-ba97-a535f3df79ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/232177ff-ab4c-491f-9ab2-9e9c2e755dba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lauren Boebert
That distinction is important. Boebert appearing in a bikini does not automatically make the picture a thirst trap. People wear bathing suits at the beach. But once the political ecosystem deliberately recirculates that picture as part of "Hot Girl Summer" celebration of conservative women, it becomes political marketing through thirst.
The politician gets the attention without necessarily having to admit that attention was the point.
* * *
## Level Four: This Is Absolutely a Thirst Trap
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dBwWyTwo9sMQkszw6tFXHZ0VrULIuf6rLLnVOIyh4rU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212423615)
Then we arrive at the real thing.
This is when the politician or political figure deliberately releases sexualized content because they know people will look, share, comment, joke, and thirst.
Nancy Mace has entered this category.
After losing her run for governor, the outgoing Republican congresswoman launched a YouTube show called _Get Maced_. The opening montage includes Mace showing off her new tattoos, walking out of the ocean with a surfboard, firing guns, and [lounging in a black bikini](https://substack.com/redirect/ec724f31-1aac-4122-b543-d4336240243a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c1dd9a5-75eb-4403-86be-797ed3b06873?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nancy Mace
Mace has explained that the tattoos have personal meaning and were connected to trauma, pain, and reclaiming her body. That explanation is sincere.
But she also deliberately put the bikini footage in the opening montage of her new media show.
Nobody accidentally edits a poolside bikini selfie into the introduction of a political YouTube program. That is a branding decision.
**That is a thirst trap.**
Former New York City Mayor Eric Adams recently posted a shirtless picture of himself in his kitchen holding an extra-large cucumber in one hand and a red pepper in the other. He said the post was about healthy eating and being in the best shape of his life at 65.
I am sure that was the message.
I am also sure that [Eric Adams knew exactly what the internet would do with a shirtless picture of him holding an enormous cucumber](https://substack.com/redirect/d99c2cb8-22e8-46c2-8cb0-2c5300b0a111?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/955eefc6-b374-4bc6-be38-9922aaf7b3dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eric Adams
That picture crossed the border from health flex to thirst trap the moment he selected the cucumber.
Then there is Brian Sims, the former Pennsylvania state representative, LGBTQ+ activist, and what at least one publication has called a "certified DILF."
Sims posted a shirtless selfie with the caption, ["Shirts?!? In this economy?"](https://substack.com/redirect/b11657f6-8b2b-4e84-9613-097dfdf14808?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) He later celebrated Pride with a professional photo shoot featuring him [shirtless and posing in Calvin Klein underwear](https://substack.com/redirect/ad2d63f4-4b30-4479-b91d-e16c461c3e9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Brian Sims
Sims has connected those pictures to queer visibility, confidence, and political resistance. That political meaning can be genuine.
They are also thirst traps.
Both things can be true.
* * *
## Has Sex Appeal Become Political Currency
Politicians have always been performers.
Their voices, clothing, hair, spouses, families, physical health, and personal stories have always been part of the product. JFK understood television. Reagan understood performance. Obama understood social media. Trump understands spectacle.
What is different now is that politicians can publish directly to millions of people without a newspaper editor, television producer, or campaign reporter standing between them and the audience.
They can see immediately which pictures generate attention. They know which shirt gets more views. They know which angle creates fan edits. They know when a picture ends up in group chats, TikTok montages, reaction videos, and cable news segments.
The algorithm does not care whether you have a ten-point housing plan.
It cares whether people stop scrolling.
Sex makes people stop scrolling.
That attention can become followers. Followers can become small-dollar donors, volunteers, media appearances, fan communities, and sometimes votes. A candidate does not necessarily need people to understand the entire policy platform if enough people already feel some kind of personal attachment to the candidate.
That attachment might be ideological.
It might also be that they think Senator "My Boo" is hot.
This is not automatically bad. Attractive people are allowed to run for office. Politicians are allowed to wear bathing suits, go to the gym, have tattoos, pose for pictures, and feel good about their bodies.
There is a difference between sexualizing someone who was simply existing and a politician deliberately using sexual attention as part of a political brand. There is also a difference between demonstrating physical fitness and posting content specifically designed to make people "thirsty."
* * *
## Does Any of This Actually Win Elections?
The other question is whether thirst trapping works.
It definitely creates attention. That does not mean it creates votes.
Nancy Mace's bikini montage did not save her gubernatorial campaign. Brian Sims' internet popularity did not win him the Democratic nomination for lieutenant governor. Aaron Schock's abs did not protect him from the scandals that ended his congressional career. Eric Adams' cucumber is unlikely to create a political comeback by itself.
A person can go viral while remaining politically irrelevant. People can share a politician's picture, call them hot, make jokes, and never register to vote for them.
But political thirst trapping is not disappearing. Campaigns have discovered another tool, and politicians who are young, attractive, fit, or simply shameless enough to participate are going to use it.
We have moved from attractive politicians being sexualized by the media, to politicians flexing their health and strength, to candidates wearing exactly the right shirt so other people will sexualize them, to politicians openly creating content designed to generate thirst.
We now have political MILFs and DILFs.
The only question left is when we get the first political OnlyFans.
At this rate, the press release will explain that the monthly subscription is about transparency, democracy, and grassroots fundraising.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=15d136776e434c439dc1be9f8004d465&_e=MHAnvq3Oodo5PJE43SufW2W0i8AS3_iyneNcvC9gdrc5yn4mvQkC1xxc2jsFSyMbpP7uVBfOQZg3GalU_ccYIQDZzfB8-6ngbpt9LZ8E52xtoD1Vzf8AOUfbwhaLA2-UpFerqTRwu1J5yLojh-3g3pFBsYH91LZmM1PjlJTMHrGKfKHlPRb6KDp8ExY2tT3pf9zxlrEjLDyc84hW8QXagituhwHqA_a9R99-rIZTaSFOY-WPahef0klREUPYwHs_d1yMJVkOexcXTzY_dzmwqBDFzJpIhjAbp-A55On63G9Y4aR89bqHVOndxCxA12ba6pOkV6XnjICP9yrvVAtXFtvMODkGdwbH57H9Kh2iJ9rI-nOvwhuQIw-KAU_7Me41rxaUlxHz0v5YSUKnqsL7tnLuyEzy89Q1RjM8_W9Xp72dQMARM80z_ZTujaamvrp-zI8K1Ss21uGjrcd7QbwFDKc1H4Wyk4tqdt44_h_vcSDI1uAk7hrxU85scOkerN80anGRp2hc3TS3E1sRnbCWn_ZozZLbkNkixv7cLEYUfXVO2ymPw9YeDRs5e_WVN9hJSeDylUFQH8OEPxu2ut9YK9311dMbS64a6uTP316lIugYAFjs3Dgyd2FKaLTfzCc4udM9KqoGljlsy8w_5rznRNlLF9-Hgz5hljD4k8rSYNFXOuKpB6uP0NObTzTZkEbh)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=15d136776e434c439dc1be9f8004d465&_e=MHAnvq3Oodo5PJE43SufW2W0i8AS3_iyneNcvC9gdrc5yn4mvQkC1xxc2jsFSyMbpP7uVBfOQZg3GalU_ccYIQDZzfB8-6ngbpt9LZ8E52xtoD1Vzf8AOUfbwhaLA2-UpFerqTRwu1J5yLojh-3g3pFBsYH91LZmM1PjlJTMHrGKfKHlPRb6KDp8ExY2tT3pf9zxlrEjLDyc84hW8QXagituhwHqA_a9R99-rIZTaSFOY-WPahef0klREUPYwHs_5bCxIaQ8Cssv_PZE5oiEb5zvIGHnfeKRhLwdqGG2skmNSvFiZqUa41w9YaxVB0Q2a8LZf8ekkJ1XFECl4uy_CxLPptNJVKX1VS7EVYm1G2PtklzbZEewaqTTRZDkhpVmr0DMxlO_MXJu-U1zAhKEB_4lXzS2bxtJAsNg9yLk0V78kG1FriJlwSX34hvp9cJ1SIrAf65aUfiH63l0VK8JPNb7U0hItDu1samj0Fn9VqW1M9bgHbqdYFBpUAymBSBeu3Kcr2gIpbfYea9kVGvouAbgK4kRnDfNZ6vu0S_VxUh72ZmwNq7igfEgFBJ4vRaqq1yTX7gEmlXMHNj1IMfVxmI0FbYs5HeKepYQ5v9ZXGcJLCXHvSBxpx2S2OqiuQdx9hbvw42PFNoE3B125oekcFKI2ViCwtXYQFrUcZ8k-1QNz6N6ovrWiEnAk3JnVGf9)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. **And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.**But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=15d136776e434c439dc1be9f8004d465&_e=MHAnvq3Oodo5PJE43SufW2W0i8AS3_iyneNcvC9gdrc5yn4mvQkC1xxc2jsFSyMbpP7uVBfOQZg3GalU_ccYIQDZzfB8-6ngbpt9LZ8E52xtoD1Vzf8AOUfbwhaLA2-UpFerqTRwu1J5yLojh-3g3pFBsYH91LZmM1PjlJTMHrGKfKHlPRb6KDp8ExY2tT3pf9zxlrEjLDyc84hW8QXagituhwHqA_a9R99-rIZTaSFOY-WPahef0klREUPYwHs_zHCg4UT0LfX7W5IcaBcAVE9XGJIEdsP9YG0JEW4xj7yGRWer18I4kUu6QFIa9HKegIRLpcGh6WjmDt6CZnzrkRACiHzAWHdzDHFfWbLlz-2-Y7Rqf3Pv-g9TVoFa-rhKgIWuC3Hbo75nVuUDZvAMucukcFk0K1Rea709Jd3qCr74-8X_cApcUmJIkXiIjxc38EOnJS3WZ7phyaY351OxnCiqsstqhEfLJCpi5MsHC2YnnAgFRykh0c9Zs2X2vyp4o5PexyosV68cRIwLPMdHJwmxekLZ9ooS5OIe8C98oh9HrhmGUR6thO_jiiIATzU0uXJXCqbFS0H6UQa3-_dsbtAYf_Vpaa6TGQpMkrl04MLv_g4pTMsMP7NHr_pALaifwh44BhpxLcPTwRlnTiI6sxlK1RSogR0qqQgT_Dhsm3o5yXd7DkNWVsL_8edDtPNZ) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.**Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.**And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. **[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=15d136776e434c439dc1be9f8004d465&_e=MHAnvq3Oodo5PJE43SufW2W0i8AS3_iyneNcvC9gdrc5yn4mvQkC1xxc2jsFSyMbpP7uVBfOQZg3GalU_ccYIQDZzfB8-6ngbpt9LZ8E52xtoD1Vzf8AOUfbwhaLA2-UpFerqTRwu1J5yLojh-3g3pFBsYH91LZmM1PjlJTMHrGKfKHlPRb6KDp8ExY2tT3pf9zxlrEjLDyc84hW8QXagituhwHqA_a9R99-rIZTaSFOY-WPahef0klREUPYwHs_kP8otNhxq7bEVKss3Kjr9uAtdPPoN1McYgncZhVjwjfFci8psk3ayny3uK9AaVnrVIlcu2fqANHubFDfB3goDWsJGyoJ00hMqXYVj4tVkJUZ-c9WGJJgUJU6j1CemMrvv2g0oEWk4GFDMq0GYiAbiBaZhg2sEJyqcD235fGMID3g53BHwK7N_G0euZkpAuIl5rLxZKBL2-gDuSRyRZXlDzO3C_WZVxLnBmaFv-cMc_BcdoijQdQgA_O7MFrqzyIQhWsf53torrmVYrRKPIuo1S2nTwnI0u3LhBzJMUwLkC9wn8lIbX2VV8D8PPQEatlwJBFAS31W1sGA1Gu7NfyjINVsXe1Fc7OdONmvevp7VZ7Ah1JctictL0BK3C60xXJpFgd0DWyljqcQn1s6BY6gfPcAwgQVaPECUMCSPXJnau3T8au9MJLsZjr-QJC41LPc)** The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. **[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the clean_body: And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. | | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301

Back-to-school season was always so important to my family. And I'll have to confess in grade school, I loved it. Getting new notebooks, pencils and maybe a new lunch box was exciting.
My mom, Beverly, spent decades teaching in Nash County public schools, where I grew up and I went to school as well. Every fall, our house had that electric energy as we got ready for the start of the year. When my mom taught, she was up before sunrise getting her classroom ready for a new group of kids.
Watching her work -- nights, weekends and summers included -- showed me firsthand the lengths our public school teachers go to give children the best possible start. When I asked her why she worked so hard on lesson plans every year for so many years she said, "Every student and every year is different so I have to update, plan and make sure it works."
As the son of an amazing public school teacher and a graduate of public schools, I grew up with a deep appreciation for educators and a firsthand understanding of what a quality public education can do for a child. That stayed with me through every step of my career.
Advocating for our public schools, teachers and students has been a personal priority for me throughout my entire time in office. It will be in the United States Senate as well. You can read more about my plan to support public education [here](https://substack.com/redirect/f046fe16-8ca1-4272-b755-0943c062c77a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/261d95ec-d77d-4486-8e6b-e795ad118f7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Every August, as the end of summer drew near and the start of school neared, my mom would always tell me to be kind, work hard and have fun.
It's simple advice, but it stuck with me. And years later, when I had daughters of my own getting ready for that first day back, I passed it on to them too.
First day of school with my daughters over the years!
So as the back-to-school season begins and you find yourself returning to the classroom after a long summer, I wanted to share some advice that has been passed down to me.
1\. It's okay to be nervous -- it just means you're about to do something new. Nervous energy can be positive.
2\. Audition for the school play! Try out for your favorite sports team! Join a club. You may meet lifelong friends and you'll learn things you didn't know.
3\. A good breakfast can get you through a hard day.
4\. Be kind to others and recognize that all kids are different. Try to be the friend you'd want to sit next to at lunch.
5\. For parents, if you can afford it, help a school supply drive for children whose families can't afford it. And offer to buy some supplies for your children's classroom. Unfortunately teachers often have to spend money out of their own pockets to get them.
If there is any advice you would like to give to students returning to school, let me know in the comments below!

name: Raja
subject: "Death to Krishnamoorthi"
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
This is a disaster. | | | |
---
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.

Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.

A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.

I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.

Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.

A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.

And every single time, I have made the same choice.

Keep going.

Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.

This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.

Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch. Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Peter,

In 1994, I helped lead the biggest Republican comeback in modern history. We took back the House after 40 years in the wilderness, and we did it with a plan, the Contract with America, that every candidate signed onto before a single vote was cast.

We won because Republicans were organized and energized before the election, not after it.

First Lady Melania Trump took the podium from Treasury Sec. Scott Bessent **[to announce President Trump's most important policy yet](https://substack.com/redirect/79656e35-f7b7-46ec-899c-60445d89e98d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to benefit America's children in need.
## [Watch here:](https://substack.com/redirect/79656e35-f7b7-46ec-899c-60445d89e98d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/79656e35-f7b7-46ec-899c-60445d89e98d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/79656e35-f7b7-46ec-899c-60445d89e98d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The First lady announced[Fostering the Future Accounts,](https://substack.com/redirect/413e9536-d82d-4fe3-9d77-34d6513f920d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a new savings and investment program designed to give foster youth the same asset-building opportunities as other American children once they reach adulthood, developed with the U.S. Treasury Department.
* **The Treasury will now recognize state child welfare agencies as eligible guardians to open these accounts** for children in foster care, with federal guidance and a dedicated helpline to help states implement the program; the accounts were authorized under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
* **Twenty-three governors have already pledged to establish the accounts in their states,** with Trump calling on all 50 states, governors, and business leaders to help fund them, framing the initiative as part of her broader Fostering the Future effort to improve outcomes for foster youth.

# **Gavin Newsom signs "Stop Nick Shirley Act" limiting independent journalism exposing fraud**
Gov. Gavin Newsom signed AB 2624, dubbed the **["Stop Nick Shirley Act,"](https://substack.com/redirect/55791352-a475-49bb-a2d4-ed09be896510?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** expanding California's Safe at Home program to shield immigration-service nonprofit workers from having their information publicly shared; the law takes effect October 2027, after Newsom leaves office.
## _Related:_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3d427db8-49e8-4afe-8167-c4b28a3ae25c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Critics, including Assemblyman Carl DeMaio, argue the law could suppress investigative journalism** targeting immigration nonprofits, while bill sponsor Assemblywoman Mia Bonta says it targets doxxing and threats, not legitimate reporting. Penalties range from $10,000-$50,000 fines to potential prison time.
* **The law follows viral investigative videos from journalist Nick Shirley** alleging fraud among Somali immigrant service providers in Minnesota and California, which he says prompted the bill. A state aide's crude public jab at Shirley outside the Capitol has since drawn HR complaints.

| Hi friend, Kalliana here -- Sue's campaign manager! I wanted to forward this message from Sue inviting you to (virtually) join us TONIGHT at 7pm to get excited for the **last two weeks before the primary!** You can sign up to join us here: [https://sue4ri.com/8-24-virtual-house-party](https://sue4ri.com/8-24-virtual-house-party?t=EwgobLDjlunb) Or, feel free to hop on to the Zoom at 7! Here's the link: [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/82743048121?pwd=abbtmwSEf5kLWalakWl48hCMggVmbz.1](https://sue4ri.com/l/FveO0j2ECcdO) Hope to see you tonight!
---
**Begin forwarded message:**
> | | |
> ---
> Hi friend, It has been so encouraging to receive notes from supporters around the state who have already cast their ballot. I am so grateful for all the incredible Rhode Islanders doing their share to fight for a stronger democracy, and for the progressive future we deserve! But there are still thousands more voters who have yet to make their decision. With **only 18 days left** , we need all hands on deck to get people out to vote. This looks different for everyone. Whether it's knocking doors, sharing a social media post, donating, driving an older neighbor to the polls, writing an op-ed, or more, **now** is the time to take that one extra step. One of my greatest strengths is knowing how to effectively leverage everyone's unique backgrounds and capabilities (which is just one small part of the new energy I am excited to bring to the Lieutenant Governor's office). Oftentimes, the hardest part is knowing where to start. Fortunately, I have the perfect opportunity for you -- and one that doesn't even require you to step out of your living room. Join me tomorrow night, **Monday****August 24th, at 7pm for a virtual gathering** to get your burning questions answered, learn about my plan to take big action as Rhode Island’s next Lieutenant Governor, meet an amazing community of “do-ers,” and get excited to be a part of a progressive, results-driven movement.
> ---
> [ **SIGN UP HERE** ](https://sue4ri.com/8-24-virtual-house-party?t=aO5S0iae1obg)
> ---
> I hope to see you there. Bring yourself, a friend, your pets, and an open mind. P.S. If you are looking for other ways to get involved, [join us for virtual phonebanking](https://sue4ri.com/l/JUQ2MZARyX6B) every Thursday evening from 6-8pm and Sunday afternoon from 3-5pm! Or keep an eye on your inbox and our social media to learn about upcoming canvassing days and other events! With gratitude, Sue AnderBois

clean_body: | Hi friend, Kalliana here -- Sue's campaign manager! I wanted to forward this message from Sue inviting you to (virtually) join us TONIGHT at 7pm to get excited for the last two weeks before the primary! You can sign up to join us here: Or, feel free to hop on to the Zoom at 7! Here's the link: Hope to see you tonight! Begin forwarded message: | | | --- Hi friend, It has been so encouraging to receive notes from supporters around the state who have already cast their ballot. I am so grateful for all the incredible Rhode Islanders doing their share to fight for a stronger democracy, and for the progressive future we deserve! But there are still thousands more voters who have yet to make their decision. With only 18 days left , we need all hands on deck to get people out to vote. This looks different for everyone. Whether it's knocking doors, sharing a social media post, donating, driving an older neighbor to the polls, writing an op-ed, or more, now is the time to take that one extra step. One of my greatest strengths is knowing how to effectively leverage everyone's unique backgrounds and capabilities (which is just one small part of the new energy I am excited to bring to the Lieutenant Governor's office). Oftentimes, the hardest part is knowing where to start. Fortunately, I have the perfect opportunity for you -- and one that doesn't even require you to step out of your living room. Join me tomorrow night, MondayAugust 24th, at 7pm for a virtual gathering to get your burning questions answered, learn about my plan to take big action as Rhode Island’s next Lieutenant Governor, meet an amazing community of “do-ers,” and get excited to be a part of a progressive, results-driven movement. --- --- I hope to see you there. Bring yourself, a friend, your pets, and an open mind. P.S. If you are looking for other ways to get involved, every Thursday evening from 6-8pm and Sunday afternoon from 3-5pm! Or keep an eye on your inbox and our social media to learn about upcoming canvassing days and other events! _I wrote and submitted this op-ed last week. Since it was not published, I 'm sharing it here as you all deserve the chance to read it._
Representative Burchett, you and I are political opponents, not grade school children engaged in a battle of who can come up with the most creative taunt to shout across the school yard. The constant name-calling is getting old.
In a recent email, you called me your "radical Democrat opponent."
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/72a4e7ad-46c8-4003-8f75-a15b125fffb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tim, what about my platform - or myself - is radical?
Is it radical to believe that our government should serve the people of East Tennessee, not just corporate interests and career politicians?
Is it radical to want to use my PhD in civil engineering to advocate for investments in our region's infrastructure?
Is it radical to be a small business owner who wants East Tennesseans to have good jobs, living wages, and to be able to afford groceries, transportation, medication, and housing?
Or is it radical to hold open town halls so those you seek to represent can ask you tough questions?
Voters deserve the opportunity to choose between us on the merits of our ideas and experience, not partisan name calling.
Later on in that same email, you call my supporters "a posse of woke leftists." I'm sure the many Republicans and Independents supporting my campaign take issue with their elected official calling them "woke leftists" simply because they are unsatisfied with their current leadership in Congress and support my candidacy.
I have no interest in "making nice with the Swamp crowd", though I am interested in working across the aisle to solve the problems facing East Tennessee.
And as far as sipping "champagne" and kissing "the rings of the Washington big shots," I'd be remiss if I didn't point out that only one of us accepts corporate PAC money in this race, and it isn't me.
I don't call people who think and vote differently than me "radicals", "sewer rats," or "twisted." I'm meeting them at their doors every day, asking them what issues matter to them and how I could effectively represent them in Congress if given the chance.
And do you know what they tell me?
They're tired of the mudslinging and culture wars. They want a leader who will work across the aisle to deliver on the issues that the majority of Americans agree on: Lowering costs. Getting money out of politics. Investing in East Tennessee's infrastructure. Fixing our broken healthcare system.
I believe that our country is at its best when we can engage in civil discourse about our different ideas to solve the problems our country faces.
Do you have any ideas to share, or just insults?

**I’m sitting in the Rose Garden right now sipping a Trump Diet Soda.**
**Gorgeous day. Beautiful garden. Greatest soda ever made, and I’m not just saying that, believe me. It’s true!**
**But something’s been on my mind. I haven’t heard from you in a while!**
**I’m sitting here in the most beautiful garden in the world, maybe the most beautiful garden anywhere, and all I keep thinking about is whether you’re still with me.**
**Look, I don’t reach out like this to just anyone. I’m very selective. The people I think about, the people I keep coming back to, that’s a very short list.**
**Many people are saying it’s too short!**
**But you’re on it. You’ve always been on it!**
**Through every fight, every witch hunt, every disgusting, phony attempt to take me down, you were there. Completely and totally loyal.**
**I love loyalty!**
**That means more to me than this beautiful garden, this gorgeous day, and yes, even this incredible soda. Believe me.**
**So here’s what I need from you today. Very simple. Just let me know you’re still here with me and chip in below.**
**Before my soda gets warm, let me hear from you.**

[Don’t keep me waiting!!](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
**-PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP**

Why I'm running for re-election |
#
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137817740/642060373/946211278?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260824_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTFlZTNkN2QtY2M5Zi1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZjFkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9cqRG6qFGHiWCWvt6wupqO4s63yle0_yBbxoNmO_hOI=) Hello, it’s Governor Wes Moore. Five years ago, I had never run for political office. I was a former Army Captain, a dad to two young kids, and I ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country. But I knew more had to be done. While career politicians were saying that everything was great, **I was hearing from folks all across Maryland who were feeling left behind.** So I ran for Governor with a mission to make Maryland a state that serves all our people — and won. body:
And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8c2e67a4ab2d44c9a23502d8877ff4f8&_e=k4LqVbcgHmUoJ5V4EYptQxg-r95kc3ijzLuAQIr6z8yoSVMQlKVynI_rICO-3IUTY0eu4llQM-FoLl7bE7qY6OiV2L5JCVzhV1v73G9zB0LhsHK76X4VNBPlDoFyodZXCd7xGsLpD9LhSD_H6JuBJ8-KxfLJdT-7tnuozLGk4TJbSkAd9h2z9Cml9iCJkKHbWFW-ab51_cUHOscrJVy_AMpUpA9gbRCgp0CKaVawuMS_hGkGvzDX8fTI6MwlB1VmVdim24zrcOIp65gNiTVmf2a_4P-ChmWv07RZ4cP0hDYm-8jdBZYuB5GXs2f7b4oyUFGUspy9wCsJgNNOs-TuRDR4QKMCxYj9ae7fbWNqSlITssRtPxvmQtvvD3dYQzPkf5nPYVlSBZsp3Hu_qxEhohkR1jocnMpK4yD0Qqpb3dlZxiMG3LClhMa8mO-oqsm8WaE1dOWIY4rLfWWPs32DD9l7wxIT6HtiZdYMMz-CMpfd0KtgmMIpE8HskNaaU6f30qAZNSyC_4ePSAboxI2C-f63qtz8qZ0HWr62D06vsZLpfAueznNp3Icuf6PhLACXA-9fy2W9gSePQ6l0meUbh6od3VAr4JxrhM7SbkiceHAMuTI4vyMiq0XnOnzwbbXVHyHDGW-2J6vK11eRt2ILClSrcoWm-RTqaJ-Wpg_Pkfr9MtNReHN5CnMolxWkvR9JDCln0UPkY_1c7hFmmB15bA%3D%3D)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8c2e67a4ab2d44c9a23502d8877ff4f8&_e=k4LqVbcgHmUoJ5V4EYptQxg-r95kc3ijzLuAQIr6z8yoSVMQlKVynI_rICO-3IUTY0eu4llQM-FoLl7bE7qY6OiV2L5JCVzhV1v73G9zB0LhsHK76X4VNBPlDoFyodZXCd7xGsLpD9LhSD_H6JuBJ8-KxfLJdT-7tnuozLGk4TJbSkAd9h2z9Cml9iCJkKHbWFW-ab51_cUHOscrJVy_AMpUpA9gbRCgp0CKaVawuMS_hGkGvzDX8fTI6MwlB1Vm0xqA0iGrBRM6ERH5CuEISC4hPvoYFg3xiL4LSUqDPkq5kIzTF1_DUdDCaP402IIV1dXGT37J2H9wJAgbkiKRTfCX5lZZvtX7p8rRqRSobKVMabKsVdppFDN1s-fic21E-gk64KwMtAOYFaF4QS9fI0DA1DPIZibWbeIgL5HHemc6cRjytDXeRbdfVrPAwjYvSH9Fl9FUfshNJPxQRA4tlQjcau9PTZpXtqvusb5rB2An723IJsar5Ub5heftouQ5aaMhG4aFLiT_IW3AhrpQAPdaD1cITdeVDSg-Zka4iTzTxlwpzbl3l7WfK4fbYt5jRy4T_JGHp8imBAV0h_QZcakPr8otcSw3e7jXSvAp494CDWAtmq6V-OSySc2lH9ejmTxF7ZETuYwbl1G8-NV0uMPUzhCQTHH5t0Ndv6pLwzfy7pImcharTgbGm6FUnEK_VGSK8-2S7dfHtj6Q5Pz47Q%3D%3D)

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”
---
**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8c2e67a4ab2d44c9a23502d8877ff4f8&_e=k4LqVbcgHmUoJ5V4EYptQxg-r95kc3ijzLuAQIr6z8yoSVMQlKVynI_rICO-3IUTY0eu4llQM-FoLl7bE7qY6OiV2L5JCVzhV1v73G9zB0LhsHK76X4VNBPlDoFyodZXCd7xGsLpD9LhSD_H6JuBJ8-KxfLJdT-7tnuozLGk4TJbSkAd9h2z9Cml9iCJkKHbWFW-ab51_cUHOscrJVy_AMpUpA9gbRCgp0CKaVawuMS_hGkGvzDX8fTI6MwlB1Vmf72-ZrADrrv9tT27gVKNvjZ2YoUELoRjC5wZZixhxPUt6RQUCd-3F5SyyqBJuNXL2NhIxZFA5Cw3p2ij3w2OvBGr1NciJ3iYq9oNa43vMXxof1p3-8pqmpi9grvdFjnMb9mDO0us8RfhY3-M8dAzYAiWE5JZ1vGR8cuOlN7AmIUWAcjUKnmF3bCWM5vlh_aOD3BgBAlQrirf5IegQQKI2YPWLl5Nwt7dZtyNp5QYBVzhJNGORm_TcFsTIsUACJdnb86aVqbS0OBgL8lEZpyQoIVBtmSPy7K6VKSiqqmh_m86IaaKcuv2k4oJLhOV_cfVHeYZD-f7EFNsHFhJRijrLjpvFIWvDtrMxM7uYrHTfP31TuMzonUP1cn_oVZsvoiRktFagcLtL2g3kX1yzXcYgM_O8VFHQIUnXcRPf9WtqsDPKrBTjQfyTGnlsbA3iFZTZ9Qa85MmDAvQuFzRTUPzjQ%3D%3D)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. **And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.**But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8c2e67a4ab2d44c9a23502d8877ff4f8&_e=k4LqVbcgHmUoJ5V4EYptQxg-r95kc3ijzLuAQIr6z8yoSVMQlKVynI_rICO-3IUTY0eu4llQM-FoLl7bE7qY6OiV2L5JCVzhV1v73G9zB0LhsHK76X4VNBPlDoFyodZXCd7xGsLpD9LhSD_H6JuBJ8-KxfLJdT-7tnuozLGk4TJbSkAd9h2z9Cml9iCJkKHbWFW-ab51_cUHOscrJVy_AMpUpA9gbRCgp0CKaVawuMS_hGkGvzDX8fTI6MwlB1VmiR8cX1mHyQQ_M7yc3qCKI0QPWl23Epg466SrPdzYOZQJzp6Z0tWRfa9S2XVBb-s7SO_7Q8BPTVwtdNGL7d2iIXHLCJPBFljqnL0EejnwioSaxhpwLOKS6BLqYlSIcrbKbJIMIhPUqu8afvIJZd-CXi4gwPIDeNQK1A3b27dhFzQI_80twZD9oFU1FoG-E1g7S3UrdQfLOgwsbKFKo9qPDmHBB_EF_Kk8HcHRFE2LN5qSwg7y_FDZ7ux2D4vwSlQqLRatp790LqwBI__m6A9omxvPKSrfSLW539nIhrnaR5Ded9i44pGWKoXmt1QfHK36yek-zLQb5Xs_OPXeP4dySuiBgOp7LFlk5EeXvzHsyYjXU-iPTct-NDCzIrAOIUGAUExHyvLPqXjDSyur3tYEo-Qf8Y2eSnFGCnF9kCNqYJxNV7Lv3p1jJYwR2sEkFHvtN-CkJL_gGu3lHlIsk5csGQ%3D%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.**Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.**And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. **[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8c2e67a4ab2d44c9a23502d8877ff4f8&_e=k4LqVbcgHmUoJ5V4EYptQxg-r95kc3ijzLuAQIr6z8yoSVMQlKVynI_rICO-3IUTY0eu4llQM-FoLl7bE7qY6OiV2L5JCVzhV1v73G9zB0LhsHK76X4VNBPlDoFyodZXCd7xGsLpD9LhSD_H6JuBJ8-KxfLJdT-7tnuozLGk4TJbSkAd9h2z9Cml9iCJkKHbWFW-ab51_cUHOscrJVy_AMpUpA9gbRCgp0CKaVawuMS_hGkGvzDX8fTI6MwlB1Vmg0n25ETwMlRtYfIXltWPJQ94ryo2fmsKDSEDkqSOam4fwoe05woy3Xw-Hb1ge08RW5CoFf7U5-zkOM0B3L8fIYCl31OimlmATEvS2quUue0ryqLiZpicnPNU2cs-b9YAdpXJM9F7KXUD3XjpFGtY4i13DO3xCRFpXtRJl0LCgkINRQh1oIOpAD4r5vK3-FLtkIX3IZG_uDZFA5tYnEQpxI1R_uiV-PFClhVzZGHmmXmWsspORYyGZ1FVPYPJXsuMfHIoPpdRcwpGhuU__Xll2nU4Nm-aDyJM7L8eRoEDLVR4vGlkCD4kuxRERQpwPHOosr7LubrKPB05yizxhDVzOOo6Tw5Uyn28ibPck7m5SUDNgQZAkJkmc5ANfl-oWQbpojo4ES44NEwU1dCvBb5k4PrZHkiSVN2d8xD_3EuxBrOOFLo4DBjxp17tsYnPbTkjdlENyaVybTnX5Gu-3x-0Ow%3D%3D)** The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these clean_body: And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. | | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301

clean_body: | | | | Mike Lawler has faced Democratic politicians before, Peter. But he’s never faced someone like me. He and I are about the same age. We both grew up in the Hudson Valley. And for the last twenty years, while he’s been a political operative finding every way possible to profit off of democracy, I’ve been leading America’s sons and daughters in defense of it. I went to West Point after 9/11. I spent 16 years in the Army, deployed six times overseas, and served as Director for Counterterrorism at the White House. My life has been about service to our country and to our community. And it is very clear that this administration, and the cowards like Mike Lawler who enable it, do not care about our country or share our values – or the values of the generations of Americans who fought and sacrificed to make this country better. That’s why I’m running for Congress. body:
Greg Abbott made $20 million off of data centers — now he’s pretending to crack down.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Greg Abbott received $20 million from data center developers to do their bidding, Peter.**
Twenty _million_ dollars from an industry that wanted a friend in the governor's office. And what did they get for their investment? A governor who rolled out the red carpet while**Texans paid the price.**
Now, Abbott is trying to convince voters he's cracking down on data centers. But it looks a lot like election-year theater: After taking millions from the industry, he suddenly wants to establish rules?
**Texans aren't buying it.**
Here's the difference between Abbott and me: I don't answer to data center developers, mega donors, or corporate PACs. I answer to the people of Texas.
And the people of Texas deserve a governor who puts their interests first, not the highest bidder.
**Let's make sure Greg Abbott learns that lesson on Election Day.**
