name: Public Land Warriors
subject: AI data centers built on our public lands
body:
This is just the beginning unless we stop it

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Q8SHTM5Yh5IM5-h73hXLBA~~/AAUS1hA~/DTUhXy0BR2swlkCa3deL207DeibbE9SToqsniGN5-t72Nh0LmIN14R-GAcw781wqKUDkKBPdaoC0BbTvyJgPlcEvv1hp0wKlQMwREMIwZ0o_QE4f26ASv3XIqFB3J3-S)
| | | | Peter, A few weeks ago, the Bureau of Land Management quietly approved a massive AI data center on 80 acres of federal public land just outside of Boulder City, Nevada. **It is the very first AI data center approved on public land in the United States,** and it is the direct result of the President’s new executive order instructing federal agencies to hand over our national real estate to billion-dollar tech companies. Here is how corrupt this process actually is: The Nevada parcel was originally approved for a 19-megawatt solar farm. The developer realized there was more money in AI, so they went back to the BLM and asked to switch it to a massive, gas-powered data center instead. **The federal government rubber-stamped the bait-and-switch without a single town hall, without a new environmental review, and without allowing the public or the local city council to say a word.** They know that if they tried to build these massive, water-guzzling, power-hungry server farms in regular neighborhoods, local residents would revolt the way we’ve seen all over the country. So they found a loophole: _they are just going to build them on federal land where they can cut you out of the process entirely._ [**This is a five-alarm fire for our public lands. Will you rush a $3 donation today to our rapid-response war chest to help us take on the billionaires and their AI data centers before this becomes the blueprint for the entire West?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NL1UR5hJVg1xe6rvxXa2jw~~/AAUS1hA~/ZkA9-Ttqdi_hmjexY4enl__hvec3ffYnqTuQcy7YMxOishvPMF0T2ZA47vR1l62es1CgCPqSUKYFmSO5uvbRKWAfT4t0es252Nlbj1KtOTSIoWV_lqdzSP1E6QLw5ScU44DlI09Gd1N3wCgthTb23OtWc4UQj1WDD9Jbr5yEcs3vSeH6Y5-uSdHlWJvEVD9sH3L2VYa7Y6u3ZX3w1ceiVM9UsUBddY4cgRHeZUCO2EPR8_mUW-_AgdQRHo-epiZ4) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/eSO89BBWLyVxWNL1DqZQLA~~/AAUS1hA~/Y7u5-5p5lZZ2Ftt0z-ouu0BMpNGqTqlUl4ES0JiL4dnoL5qi5c439fsa8jxsyYUzf6mZBJUd7Xjx99dLS2UlG2DvwmIUWrG_qt0V-QVB8PyLHao3aIUXkU43De5nUcvzlWRE00Liy566QUv-cr1g-LzobqGBAq4pg77eCRDmLwefNOJ3h832jSMtCIdl0IHiTqzAXbOWXmd4o3mNV0lRDGqgvCDSeaUCH-Z_ydZzLMqlYKIaLBfzTyT1tVVHvI2J) ** Right now, states like Wyoming are watching this closely. The BLM manages 18 million acres of land in Wyoming alone, and the tech lobby is desperate for cheap land and cheap energy to fuel their AI expansion. If they get away with this backroom deal in Nevada, they will replicate it across millions of acres of public lands from the Mojave Desert to the Rocky Mountains. They are trying to turn our shared national heritage into a private, taxpayer-subsidized power grid for the tech elite. At Public Land Warriors, we are fighting back and building the rapid-response infrastructure to expose these backroom deals and turn this corporate land grab into a political death sentence for the politicians cheering it on. We are going to ensure that every voter knows exactly who sold off our deserts and prairies to Big Tech. [**Will you pitch in $3, or whatever you can afford today, to help us launch the counter-offensive and stop these data centers in their tracks?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NL1UR5hJVg1xe6rvxXa2jw~~/AAUS1hA~/ZkA9-Ttqdi_hmjexY4enl__hvec3ffYnqTuQcy7YMxOishvPMF0T2ZA47vR1l62es1CgCPqSUKYFmSO5uvbRKWAfT4t0es252Nlbj1KtOTSIoWV_lqdzSP1E6QLw5ScU44DlI09Gd1N3wCgthTb23OtWc4UQj1WDD9Jbr5yEcs3vSeH6Y5-uSdHlWJvEVD9sH3L2VYa7Y6u3ZX3w1ceiVM9UsUBddY4cgRHeZUCO2EPR8_mUW-_AgdQRHo-epiZ4) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/eSO89BBWLyVxWNL1DqZQLA~~/AAUS1hA~/Y7u5-5p5lZZ2Ftt0z-ouu0BMpNGqTqlUl4ES0JiL4dnoL5qi5c439fsa8jxsyYUzf6mZBJUd7Xjx99dLS2UlG2DvwmIUWrG_qt0V-QVB8PyLHao3aIUXkU43De5nUcvzlWRE00Liy566QUv-cr1g-LzobqGBAq4pg77eCRDmLwefNOJ3h832jSMtCIdl0IHiTqzAXbOWXmd4o3mNV0lRDGqgvCDSeaUCH-Z_ydZzLMqlYKIaLBfzTyT1tVVHvI2J) ** They think they can quietly auction off our wild spaces without a fight. It is the very first AI data center approved on public land in the United States, and it is the direct result of the President’s new executive order instructing federal agencies to hand over our national real estate to billion-dollar tech companies. Here is how corrupt this process actually is: The Nevada parcel was originally approved for a 19-megawatt solar farm. The developer realized there was more money in AI, so they went back to the BLM and asked to switch it to a massive, gas-powered data center instead. The federal government rubber-stamped the bait-and-switch without a single town hall, without a new environmental review, and without allowing the public or the local city council to say a word. They know that if they tried to build these massive, water-guzzling, power-hungry server farms in regular neighborhoods, local residents would revolt the way we’ve seen all over the country. So they found a loophole: they are just going to build them on federal land where they can cut you out of the process entirely. Right now, states like Wyoming are watching this closely. The BLM manages 18 million acres of land in Wyoming alone, and the tech lobby is desperate for cheap land and cheap energy to fuel their AI expansion. If they get away with this backroom deal in Nevada, they will replicate it across millions of acres of public lands from the Mojave Desert to the Rocky Mountains. They are trying to turn our shared national heritage into a private, taxpayer-subsidized power grid for the tech elite. At Public Land Warriors, we are fighting back and building the rapid-response infrastructure to expose these backroom deals and turn this corporate land grab into a political death sentence for the politicians cheering it on. We are going to ensure that every voter knows exactly who sold off our deserts and prairies to Big Tech. They think they can quietly auction off our wild spaces without a fight. Let's make sure it costs them their jobs. For the wild, Public Land Warriors | Public Land Warriors728 Gilbert StHelena, MT 59601United States "Website"

# An update on our Gaza reporting, and a thank you
### This community has real power. You just proved it again.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Aug 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
We had another fundraising email ready to send today, but we're not sending it. Instead we wanted to take a minute and just say thank you.
Last week, we told you that three readers pledged $45,000 to support our Gaza and West Bank reporting and they asked if the rest of our readers would meet them. You didn't just meet them, you blew past them. Together, this community has raised over $60,000 since last Wednesday, well beyond our $45,000 match goal, all of it going directly to our reporting from Gaza and the West Bank and to the Palestinian journalists bravely doing that reporting on the ground.
The response from this community has been inspiring and we are all filled with so much gratitude. It means more reporting. It means more support for the journalists who have kept working through two years of genocide, documenting what no one else can. It means we get to say yes to more investigations instead of figuring out what we have to say no to.
This is what this community does. You came together to help us defend our reporting when a lawsuit tried to bury us in legal costs designed to shut us up. You came together to fund tuition for a young Pakistani journalist, Areeba Fatima, to attend journalism school in the States ([she graduated this month!](https://substack.com/redirect/5ca2dc6b-7dbe-46ef-acdf-82f52495d869?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). And now you've done it again, funding our reporting and investigations from Gaza and the West Bank and backing the brave journalists on the ground who keep doing that work despite being violently targeted for doing their jobs. This community has real power, and you are the reason Drop Site exists at all, and the reason it keeps getting stronger.
So, thank you. Genuinely. From everyone here at Drop Site, and from our journalists on the ground in Gaza and the West Bank whose work this directly supports.
If you haven't given yet and still want to, [this is still open](https://substack.com/redirect/c8f85881-cd17-4256-95d5-4d750991b41c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We're not closing the door on it just because we hit the number, this reporting isn't cheap and it isn't done, and every gift still goes straight to the same place.
[Support our Gaza & West Bank reporting ->](https://substack.com/redirect/c8f85881-cd17-4256-95d5-4d750991b41c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And if you're someone who has the capacity to do what those three readers did, to make a large gift or think about a partnership on something like this in the future, we'd love to talk. A handful of people go big, thousands of you show up behind them, and real journalism happens because of it. If that's you, please reach out to us at majorgiving@dropsitenews.com. We'd love to talk about what that could look like.
Thank you for being part of this.
(C) 2026 Drop Site News, Inc.

Ste B2 #1034, Washington, DC 20009

name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: Wildlife Wins: Colorado welcomes a new wolf pack!
body:
Positive news about our wild world, delivered straight to your inbox!

Positive news about our wild world, delivered straight to your inbox!
                  

                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5926045/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

Incredible things are happening in the world of conservation every day, thanks to dedicated people and their supporters. Each month, we’ll bring you uplifting stories about wildlife and wild places!

 

Colorado Confirms Formation of a New Pack of Gray Wolves!

This past month, Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) confirmed that a new pack of gray wolves, the Piney Ridge Pack, has formed – and the pack has seen newly born pups!

Four wolf packs have seen successful reproduction this year. Those litters of pups are part of a new generation of wolves that are making their mark in Colorado, where efforts to reintroduce gray wolves began in recent years. And being part of a pack will help these pups survive and carry on that legacy!

What a Florida Panther Sighting at a Solar Plant Means for Habitat

An endangered Florida panther was recently seen moving through a solar plant located in south Florida, (https://support.defenders.org/s/5926046/38SyG9Xl) suggesting that measures to preserve habitat connectivity are succeeding!

FPL worked with Defenders and others to plan solar projects in the area to allow local wildlife to continue moving through the landscape, using design elements such as openings in the plant’s perimeter. As habitat has been fragmented by road construction and development, the sighting of this imperiled panther shows that sensible planning can help animals roam while coexisting with humans!

Judge Halts Road Construction Through Izembek National Wildlife Refuge

Just last week, a federal just vacated a closed-door land deal between the federal government and an Alaskan corporation (https://support.defenders.org/s/5926047/38SyG9Xl) that would have allowed almost 20 miles of road construction through the Izembek National Wildlife Refuge.

Izembek is an essential migration stopover for millions of waterfowl such as geese and swans, and it’s also home to sea otters, caribou, brown bears and more. This decision puts a stop to reckless road development and protects irreplaceable habitat that these animals depend on for survival!

Defenders relies on members like you power ongoing conservation efforts nationwide. Learn how you can lend your support and make a difference with us! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5926048/38SyG9Xl)

| | | I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.

Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to**"Death to Krishnamoorthi"** at the top of their lungs.

A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.

I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.

Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.

A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a **"foreign occupier"** with an **"unpronounceable name"** and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.

And every single time, I have made the same choice.

Keep going.

Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.

This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.

**Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch**. Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.

Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.

About RNC Chairman Joe Gruters:Joe is a fourth generation Sarasotan and descendent of Ringling Circus chief tentmaker William Hobson, his great grandfather who moved the family to Sarasota in 1922. A 1996 graduate of Cardinal Mooney High School, Joe is also a graduate of both Florida State University, where he earned his undergraduate degree, and the University of South Florida, where he earned his MBA. Joe is a partner at Robinson Gruters and Roberts, a CPA firm with offices in Sarasota County. For the last 25 years, Joe has been working at the grassroots level as both a Republican Party activist and leader. He served as Chairman of the Republican Party of Sarasota for 14 years, Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida for 4 years where he was undefeated in state wide elections and served as member of the Republican National Committee for 4 years where he served as Chairman of the Election Integrity committee. Joe has also served as a member of the Electoral College representing Florida during the 2016 and 2020 elections and was the co chairman of the 2016 Republican National Committees platform committee on Restoring the American Dream. Joe currently serves as a State Senator representing Sarasota and Manatee Counties. He serves as the Florida Senate Regulated Industries Chairman. Joe is an active member of the Sarasota County community and local government. He has served as Chairman of the Sarasota County Planning Commission, on the Board of Directors for the Florida Sports Foundation, as Treasurer for the Sarasota Humane Society and as a Governor Rick Scott Appointee to the Board of Trustees for Florida State University, where he was Chairman of the Finance and Audit Committee and Presidential Compensation Committee. Joe currently serves on the University of South Florida Community Leadership Counsel at the Sarasota Campus. Joe is married to Sydney and they have three children – Spencer, Jack and Elizabeth.

Scott MaltzieChairman

| | Dear David, This weekend, our volunteers gathered the postcards they’ve written, grabbed the stamps that people like you generously helped pay for, and got them in the mail. **They mailed out _35,000_ postcards to voters across the district.** Take a look: [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/1NyjjqAKmDVo1TI_wkPOQA~~/AAUS1hA~/hv9Rs9W9rnIBvaWy3V0wU6vZYhx9b1MC4MuztWKsUFzBS-kMhs7hWTthmUBSPY8uLRY-M7ibMgqRMTA72OfZOKoZ_GpCPFLqgbEPE07v6PlKjh9OkMWpS29_3utz3E2k5rA9vZWu_-lrJQ2W8Z9zlP8MVt3PpAOQ5uk2n8EBsOvALe55nNghFBZIFKmRco_C8ZF86vYUEfDUsWW5drZ4vnkpgsYDu2sO5aLV9ZpVh2sFBek5sWUqKiSrbKRWWUFr0vlyk-XEmalOxfl_yQJLaA~~) The energy behind this project has been nothing short of amazing. So many volunteers have shown up for us and written far more postcards than we expected, and so many grassroots supporters like you have helped us get them out to folks across the district by paying for stamps. Peter, It’s officially one of my favorite times of the year – back to school! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137823808/642083267/1562923295?amount=10&source=VF_EM_FR_082426_B1_BacktoSchool&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDZjZjE1ZC1kNjlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XQmCrrhGtpNnLvTJR41uhiqp7kSvGgAnY3GnkF2felA=) As parents and children prepare to return to the classroom, these days in August always transport me back to the era of my life when my sons were in school. When my boys were young, my husband and I were both working full-time. As soon as I got off the night shift from the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to my sons’ classrooms to volunteer. Not only did this serve as an opportunity for me to spend more precious time with my children, **but it opened my eyes to the social disparities affecting students firsthand, especially Black and brown kids, in the classroom.** This launched my career in public service, Peter. When I could do nothing more as a volunteer, I ran for School Board. And as the story goes, I ended up here, in Congress. Back to school should be an exciting time where our children are eager to make new friends, expand their horizons, and learn without boundaries. This time of year should not be clouded with anxiety about budget cuts, inadequate supplies, or if our children are in danger while at school. **Our children deserve to return to school this year feeling safe, prepared, and excited to learn. ** The opportunity to learn is not only a blessing but a fundamental right — and every single child deserves equal access to a quality education. **[Education is one of my highest and most urgent priorities in Congress. That’s why I’m in Congress fighting for public education day in and day out. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | = Peter, It’s officially one of my favorite times of the year – back to school! = As parents and children prepare to return to the classroom, these days in August always transport me back to the era of my life when my sons were in school. When my boys were young, my husband and I were both working full-time. As soon as I got off the night shift from the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to my sons’ classrooms to volunteer. Not only did this serve as an opportunity for me to spend more precious time with my children, but it opened my eyes to the social disparities affecting students firsthand, especially Black and brown kids, in the classroom. This launched my career in public service, Peter. When I could do nothing more as a volunteer, I ran for School Board. And as the story goes, I ended up here, in Congress. Back to school should be an exciting time where our children are eager to make new friends, expand their horizons, and learn without boundaries. This time of year should not be clouded with anxiety about budget cuts, inadequate supplies, or if our children are in danger while at school. Our children deserve to return to school this year feeling safe, prepared, and excited to learn. clean_body: = Trump’s ICE is preparing to spend up to $20 million on wearable electric-shock devices — gloves agents can put on their hands and use to hurt people at close range. They want to use your taxpayer money to turn an agent's hand into a weapon. The request is coming from the same agency that already operates with too much secrecy, too little accountability, and a long record of refusing to answer basic questions about how people are treated in its custody. If Democrats flip the House, I will be in a position to chair the House Oversight Committee. That means ICE will not get to hide from us. We will demand answers. Who approved this contract? Who profits from it? What rules govern when agents can shock someone? What happens when those rules are broken? And why is an agency already accused of abuse being handed new tools to inflict pain before it has answered for the harm it has already caused? ICE should not get a blank check to buy shock weapons. body:
I gave a name that was not mine at an Alaska polling place. No ID.
“Absolutely possible.” Now the Senator's office wants me
prosecuted.

View in Web Browser [/https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e6575001/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvanQ2R21ZYlk3Qw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MjQ/LbmNsUnZQU0dLTg/qP2hpZHM9bmM4YTZTdlpqQzRFWjVsc10/gaoxvyA/sdvf6dc319f

[O'Keefe Media Group]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

NEW INVESTIGATION · ALASKA

THE BIG
MURKOWSKI

Anchorage. Primary day. No ID required.

This investigation cost $50,000. Help us fund the next one.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Dear Patriot,

Stand at that table with me for a second.

Anchorage, Alaska. Primary day. There is a folding table, a laminated
binder, and a perfectly nice woman working the poll book the way she
probably has for years.

I give her a name.

It is not my name. The name is BRIAN MURKOWSKI. He is the brother of a
sitting United States Senator. He does not live in Alaska. He lives in
Texas.

[Watch: The Big Murkowski Ballot Scandal — watch and donate]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Then I tell her the one thing that is supposed to stop all of this
cold.

I tell her I DO NOT HAVE MY ID.

She looks up at me and says:

“Absolutely possible.”

ANCHORAGE POLL WORKER · AUGUST 18, 2026

I want you to watch this one for yourself. And then I want you to help
me pay for the next one. YOU CAN CHIP IN RIGHT HERE.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

I asked her again anyway, because I wanted it recorded and I wanted it
to be completely unmistakable to anyone who watched it later. All I
have to do is fill out the question ballot, and then I can vote?

“YES, SIR.”

We titled the video “THE BIG MURKOWSKI,” and you really do have to
laugh a little bit at it, because the only other available option is
putting your head through a wall.

The funny part ends fast. EVERY SINGLE THING I AM ABOUT TO TELL YOU
MAKES THE THING BEFORE IT WORSE.

ONE. A total stranger walked in off the street carrying no
identification of any kind and was offered a ballot.

TWO. The name on that ballot belongs to a United States Senator's
brother who lives roughly three thousand miles away, in another state
entirely.

THREE. We did it again. Different polling place, same morning. One of
my reporters gave the name KARINA WALLER — Senator Murkowski's own
STATE DIRECTOR. No ID. Same offer. HELP US KEEP DOING EXACTLY THIS.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

FOUR. Alaska law says you show identification to get a ballot, and the
one narrow exception written into it is that the poll worker
personally knows the person standing in front of them. Nobody in
either of those buildings had ever laid eyes on us before in their
lives.

FIVE. Nobody wrote anything down. Nobody picked up a phone. Nobody
flagged a single thing. We asked, we got our answer, and we walked
back out the door.

Now here is the part that should stop you cold.

Senator Murkowski has spent this year fighting the SAVE Act, which her
office describes as “an overly burdensome, one-size-fits-all mandate
from Washington,” and the argument underneath that position has
always been the same one we hear everywhere: that the hole we keep
describing does not actually exist outside of our imagination.

WE JUST SHOWED HER THE HOLE. IN HER OWN STATE. USING HER OWN BROTHER'S
NAME.

Before anyone calls this a partisan hit job, let me say it plainly:
Senator Murkowski is a Republican, and it does not matter to me even a
little, because a hole in the process is a hole in the process and it
does not care one bit about which party happens to walk through it.

Her office did not say they were going to fix it.

Her office said this:

“Voter impersonation is a crime and should be prosecuted to the
fullest extent of the law.”
OFFICE OF SEN. LISA MURKOWSKI

Now I want to be precise with you about what we did and did not do,
because you fund this operation and you deserve that kind of
accounting from me.

I DID NOT VOTE. I DID NOT SIGN ANYONE'S NAME. I NEVER TOUCHED A
BALLOT. I asked a question, I recorded the answer, and I left. That is
what reporters do.

The response from a sitting United States Senator's office was to
start talking about prosecuting me for it.

Patriot, this has become a pattern, and I want you to see it as
clearly as I have come to see it over the last three weeks.

Last week the Secretary of State of Minnesota published a statement
accusing my journalists of “LYING, LAWBREAKING, AND DISRUPTIONS”
and announced that LAW ENFORCEMENT IS REVIEWING them. He never named a
single law we broke.

This week the office of a United States Senator is talking about
prosecuting a journalist to the fullest extent of the law.

Michigan. Minnesota. Alaska. Three states in three weeks, and every
single time we have gone looking, we have found the same hole sitting
there in plain sight. Nobody ever rushes to close the hole. THEY COME
AFTER THE PERSON HOLDING THE FLASHLIGHT.

GIVE NOW — FUND THE NEXT STATE
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Let me tell you what Alaska cost.

$50,000

What this single investigation cost to produce — so that you could
hear two words said out loud at a folding table in Anchorage.

That covered the flights to Anchorage and back, the weeks of
preparation before anyone ever got on a plane, the records work, the
equipment, and a team standing on the ground at dawn on primary day
three thousand miles from our office. It also covered the lawyers who
reviewed every frame of that footage before a single second of it went
to air, because we understood exactly what was coming the moment it
did.

I would spend every dollar of it again tomorrow morning without
blinking. Here is my problem. WE DO NOT HAVE ANOTHER FIFTY THOUSAND
DOLLARS SITTING IN A DRAWER WAITING FOR THE NEXT STATE.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

And there is a next one. There is always a next one.

Alaska is not special. Alaska is simply the state we happened to be
standing in on Tuesday, and everything you are about to watch came out
of a single morning and one honest question asked out loud at a
folding table. IMAGINE WHAT IS SITTING UNTOUCHED IN THE OTHER
FORTY-NINE.

IN TWENTY-EIGHT DAYS, THE FIRST FEDERAL BALLOTS FOR NOVEMBER GO OUT.
After that date the machine is running, and everything we have not
found yet gets voted on anyway.

You and your family have to live under whatever comes out of those
buildings, and so does mine, and that is the entire reason I keep
walking into them with a camera when it would be far easier and
considerably safer not to.

There is nobody else writing this check, and there never has been. It
has always been you.

YES, JAMES — I'LL HELP FUND THE NEXT ONE
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Thank you for everything you do.
In Truth,[James O'Keefe]
James O'Keefe
Founder, O'Keefe Media Group

P.S. The video is called “THE BIG MURKOWSKI,” and I hope it makes
you laugh. Then I hope it makes you furious. A stranger with no ID was
offered a United States Senator's brother's ballot, and the Senator's
office answered by talking about prosecuting the man who filmed it.
THAT IS EXACTLY WHY THIS CANNOT STOP — AND YOU ARE THE ONLY REASON
IT DOES NOT HAVE TO.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

RUSH YOUR GIFT NOW
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

We asked, we got our answer, and we walked back out the door. Now here is the part that should stop you cold. Senator Murkowski has spent this year fighting the SAVE Act, which her office describes as “an overly burdensome, one-size-fits-all mandate from Washington,” and the argument underneath that position has always been the same one we hear everywhere: that the hole we keep describing does not actually exist outside of our imagination. WE JUST SHOWED HER THE HOLE. IN HER OWN STATE. USING HER OWN BROTHER'S NAME. Before anyone calls this a partisan hit job, let me say it plainly: Senator Murkowski is a Republican, and it does not matter to me even a little, because a hole in the process is a hole in the process and it does not care one bit about which party happens to walk through it. Her office did not say they were going to fix it. Her office said this: “Voter impersonation is a crime and should be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.” OFFICE OF SEN. LISA MURKOWSKI Now I want to be precise with you about what we did and did not do, because you fund this operation and you deserve that kind of accounting from me. I DID NOT VOTE. I DID NOT SIGN ANYONE'S NAME. I NEVER TOUCHED A BALLOT. I asked a question, I recorded the answer, and I left. That is what reporters do. The response from a sitting United States Senator's office was to start talking about prosecuting me for it. Patriot, this has become a pattern, and I want you to see it as clearly as I have come to see it over the last three weeks. Last week the Secretary of State of Minnesota published a statement accusing my journalists of “LYING, LAWBREAKING, AND DISRUPTIONS” and announced that LAW ENFORCEMENT IS REVIEWING them. He never named a single law we broke. This week the office of a United States Senator is talking about prosecuting a journalist to the fullest extent of the law. Michigan. Minnesota. Alaska. Three states in three weeks, and every single time we have gone looking, we have found the same hole sitting there in plain sight. Nobody ever rushes to close the hole. THEY COME AFTER THE PERSON HOLDING THE FLASHLIGHT. GIVE NOW — FUND THE NEXT STATE [ Let me tell you what Alaska cost. $50,000 What this single investigation cost to produce — so that you could hear two words said out loud at a folding table in Anchorage. That covered the flights to Anchorage and back, the weeks of preparation before anyone ever got on a plane, the records work, the equipment, and a team standing on the ground at dawn on primary day three thousand miles from our office. It also covered the lawyers who reviewed every frame of that footage before a single second of it went to air, because we understood exactly what was coming the moment it did. I would spend every dollar of it again tomorrow morning without blinking. Here is my problem. WE DO NOT HAVE ANOTHER FIFTY THOUSAND DOLLARS SITTING IN A DRAWER WAITING FOR THE NEXT STATE. [ And there is a next one. There is always a next one. Alaska is not special. Alaska is simply the state we happened to be standing in on Tuesday, and everything you are about to watch came out of a single morning and one honest question asked out loud at a folding table. IMAGINE WHAT IS SITTING UNTOUCHED IN THE OTHER FORTY-NINE. IN TWENTY-EIGHT DAYS, THE FIRST FEDERAL BALLOTS FOR NOVEMBER GO OUT. After that date the machine is running, and everything we have not found yet gets voted on anyway. You and your family have to live under whatever comes out of those buildings, and so does mine, and that is the entire reason I keep walking into them with a camera when it would be far easier and considerably safer not to. There is nobody else writing this check, and there never has been. It has always been you. YES, JAMES — I'LL HELP FUND THE NEXT ONE [ Thank you for everything you do. In Truth,[James O'Keefe] James O'Keefe Founder, O'Keefe Media Group P.S. The video is called “THE BIG MURKOWSKI,” and I hope it makes you laugh. Then I hope it makes you furious. A stranger with no ID was offered a United States Senator's brother's ballot, and the Senator's office answered by talking about prosecuting the man who filmed it. THAT IS EXACTLY WHY THIS CANNOT STOP — AND YOU ARE THE ONLY REASON IT DOES NOT HAVE TO. [ RUSH YOUR GIFT NOW [ [O'Keefe Media Group] [

**Monday, August 24, 2026 -**_** ** Israeli strikes kill six Palestinians on Monday. Palestinian man executed by Israel in Gaza, family says. Israeli forces kill Palestinian child, settler assaults elderly amputee as attacks continue across the West Bank. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz says Israeli military will act "forcefully" over kites from Gaza. Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad to be detained without charge for months. Canada "at war" over trade after U.S.-Canada talks collapse, oil supply squeeze looming for U.S. refiners. U.S. Postal Service moves forward with mail-in ballot restrictions. Trump made more than 1,000 stock trades in June, disclosure shows. Migrants who resisted deportation flight to Liberia forced onward to Equatorial Guinea. Federal judge strikes down Trump administration's visa ban on 75 countries. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries met privately with Jared Kushner. Israel strikes Syria near the Golan Heights. U.S. envoy suggests Israel bombed Syria's Abu al-Duhur airbase to "bait" Turkey. Ukraine strikes Russian refinery, Russians strike Ukrainian mall. Sudanese Army strikes inside Chad. Venezuela unable to ship oil, Reuters reports. Embattled Mexican governor Ruben Rocha out again. Germany records over 14,000 heat-related deaths. DR Congo and M23 rebels agree on peace roadmap in Switzerland. Video shows hundreds held captive after mass abduction from Nigerian mosque._

* * *
# Palestine
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, two Palestinians were killed and 32 were injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,422 killed, with 174,401 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,288 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 4,290, while 813 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble.
* **Israeli strikes kill six Palestinians on Monday:** At least six Palestinians, including a child, were killed in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on Monday, Al Jazeera reported. A Palestinian was killed and others wounded when Israeli forces [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/e6168725-467a-485d-966e-09f34061d68c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a tent sheltering displaced people near Al-Aqsa Martyrs hospital in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, WAFA reported. Separately, another Palestinian died from wounds sustained in an Israeli airstrike on the Gaza City port area last Tuesday which killed seven. Israeli forces targeted a mosque and a water desalination plant in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan district.
* **Israel continues to kill in Gaza over the weekend despite "ceasefire"**:
* An Israeli drone struck a home in the Al-Bassa area north of Deir al-Balah on Saturday, killing one Palestinian man and wounding another. Separately, a woman was shot by Israeli forces near Nuseirat.
* Israeli artillery [shelled](https://substack.com/redirect/2be16e38-1426-4a48-83d0-255ea8d1195f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) areas around Al-Bureij, Khan Younis, and eastern Gaza City on Saturday, including homes in Khan Younis' Al-Amal neighborhood.
* On Sunday, Israeli forces [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/6f7fcafe-3f92-404f-bdb0-53126f24a58e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian in Al-Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza. In a separate airstrike near Al-Zawayda, Israel [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/489da92b-6b29-4440-942a-bd84d35b7738?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 4-year-old Palestinian, sources told Drop Site, wounding two others Palestinian in the same strike.
* Israeli tanks also [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/aebf8db2-3c83-42a6-8bc6-e07dc97a01df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) toward displacement tents near Asdaa City and Hamad Towers, warships opened fire off Rafah, and artillery shelling was reported in northern Al-Bureij on Sunday.
* **Palestinian man executed by Israel in Gaza, family says:** The family of Ibrahim Mohammed Kawarea [says](https://substack.com/redirect/24454906-237a-4916-a998-24cabc3a5751?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israeli forces executed the father of three after detaining him near the "Yellow Line" east of Khan Younis on Friday, according to Felesteen.
* Kawarea was suffering a severe mental health crisis. Relatives said his state of mind had worsened after his cousin had been killed days earlier.
* His uncle, Jaber Kawarea, said Ibrahim's body arrived at Nasser Medical Complex with multiple gunshot wounds to his head, chest, and abdomen--some apparently fired at close range--and his legs were still bound. "We were shocked that his legs were also tied," he said.
* The family described his killing as a "field execution" and is demanding an international investigation.
* **Israeli forces kill Palestinian child, settler assaults elderly amputee as attacks continue across the West Bank:**
* **Nablus** : Israeli forces shot and [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb1eccb-b44d-46e3-a03e-cb7825e90f96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 14-year-old Palestinian during a raid on New Askar refugee camp, east of Nablus, on Sunday. Israeli forces also continued their siege of three Palestinian homes in Qusra for the third consecutive week on Sunday, restricting movement and blocking aid and solidarity groups, while allowing settlers to move freely around the besieged homes. Israeli attackers [withdrew](https://substack.com/redirect/0ffe0797-5f50-42fb-a272-115a75d76e2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday from one of these homes after occupying it for 10 days, but remained stationed outside the property.
* **Hebron:** An Israeli settler [assaulted](https://substack.com/redirect/5eff78bb-d257-4a79-adec-55c4ba11d856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an elderly Palestinian amputee in Masafer Yatta on Saturday, while another videotaped it. After Saturday's assault, Israeli forces raided his home, confiscating his family's phones, per WAFA. Israel police announced on Sunday that two Israeli teenagers were arrested--the 16-year-old who clubbed the disabled Palestinian man and the 17-year-old who filmed the attack, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/8df755dc-6a5d-49cf-942d-4e4da1e2243f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Times of Israel. The 17-year-old was later released to house arrest, the police said.
* **Jordan Valley:** An Israeli settler was [stabbed](https://substack.com/redirect/642de496-b4c4-4ad5-9bfe-c8d170bfccd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday morning near the Palestinian village of Al-Auja in the occupied Jordan Valley, according to The New Arab. The 24-year-old man was being treated for his injuries as Israeli forces searched the area for the attacker. Al-Auja has been subjected to so much sustained settler violence that residents were forced to abandon the village earlier this year.
* **Katz says Israeli military will act "forcefully" over kites from Gaza: **Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/7a5fe0f7-d518-4245-8229-6aedee9d9996?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Israeli military on Sunday to "act immediately and forcefully" over kites launched from Gaza, declaring that Israel will treat every kite or balloon as an "act of war," even those carrying no explosives.
* Four kites flown from Gaza landed in Kibbutz Nahal Oz over the weekend, according to the Times of Israel. The Israeli military said nothing suspicious was found on them and they posed no danger to the public.
* "A balloon is treated like a kite, and a kite is treated like a drone, with or without explosives," Katz said, threatening those behind the launches with the "utmost severity."
* Senior Hamas official Basem Naim [responded](https://substack.com/redirect/a3c845c2-02e5-4d35-85b1-9cb984eae61d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday, writing that it was a "surreal paradox" that a "nuclear state that practices terrorism daily" would "issue orders to deal forcefully with paper kites coming out of Gaza."

* **Mohamed Awad to be detained without charge for months:** Palestinian journalist and Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad was [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/5c38260e-764d-4c18-86f0-784e2f722c8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to be held in administrative detention for four months by Israeli military authorities, according to his lawyer. Awad was arrested from his home in the village of Beitunia, near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, on August 12 by the Israeli military. Administrative detention is a mechanism by which Israeli authorities imprison Palestinians indefinitely without charge or trial.

* **Hamas tells Kushner that it will not abide by an unenforced deal:** Senior Hamas official Osama Hamdan [said](https://substack.com/redirect/d15065a7-eea4-4f18-8b3d-933f0519f107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the group told Jared Kushner in their meeting last weekend that if Israel does not publicly accept the proposed framework and begin implementing its obligations, including halting attacks and withdrawing from Gaza, Hamas will not consider itself obligated to implement any part of the deal. Hamdan made the remarks on an Iraqi podcast released this week.
* Hamdan stressed that Hamas has not agreed to surrender its weapons. He said the framework calls for heavy weapons to be restricted and stored under the authority of a Palestinian administrative committee governing Gaza, while remaining in Palestinian hands.
* He also said that none of Hamas's weapons would be transferred to any non-Palestinian party and not a single bullet would leave Gaza under the agreement.

* **Hamas discusses electoral strategy:** Hamas said in a statement that it would [contest](https://substack.com/redirect/b44110a7-dba4-4092-9ae1-925450d224fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the upcoming Palestinian legislative elections as part of the "broadest possible national alliance" to build a more unified Palestinian political system.
* Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas issued a decree on July 9 setting legislative elections for November 28 in Jerusalem, the West Bank, and Gaza. They would be the first Palestinian legislative elections since 2006. Hamas urged Abbas not to reverse course "as happened in previous stages."
* **" Anti-Netanyahu" says there will be no Palestinian state if he controls government: **Gadi Eisenkot, the former Israeli military chief of staff now leading in polls to unseat Benjamin Netanyahu in the October 27 election, [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/f88f65e9-7954-4907-8601-032665152cf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Saturday there will be no Palestinian state under a government he forms. "There is no Palestinian state, and in the government we will form, no Palestinian state will arise," he wrote on X.
* A recent New Yorker profile by editor David Remnick cast him as the "anti-Bibi" in "manner and character," a humble soldier fighting for a "Jewish, democratic, progressive, and liberal state."

# Iran
* **U.S. to announce "economic D-Day" sanctions against Iran:** Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to announce new U.S. sanctions against Iran at a press conference on Monday afternoon. In an [op-ed](https://substack.com/redirect/9758eb2a-6ad9-44c8-b9ac-ecc9b02b44d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Financial Times, Bessent wrote: "At dawn begins an economic D-Day--the single greatest financial offensive ever marshalled against an adversary. Our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains the tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone." He added that any country that "serves as a financial artery" for Iran "should expect to share in its isolation" and would become a "global pariah."
* Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei criticized the move as "a clear example of economic terrorism to punish a nation that insists on defending its sovereignty and independence." He warned that Iran would respond harshly to expanded U.S. sanctions. "Any escalation of this situation will undoubtedly bring about consequences," Baghaei said. "Our hands are not tied."
* Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/bf037d01-062c-4d34-85e9-78326a15ef32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) other countries not to join the campaign against Iran, saying that "any country participating in the imposition of economic restrictions against us is considered an enemy."
* Rezaei said Iran is prepared to target "all American oil and economic companies in the region" if Washington escalates to economic war, and that in a full economic war, Iran would let no oil leave the Persian Gulf "even through other means," signaling potential strikes on bypasses.
* **Iran permits Iraqi tankers to pass through Hormuz:** Iran [granted](https://substack.com/redirect/984598a0-2c42-4476-aed6-951d1a73e514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) special permission for a number of Iraqi oil tankers to pass through the Strait of Hormuz after repeated requests from Baghdad, IRNA reported.
* The issue was a key request during Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf's visit to Iraq. The Iraqi President said Iran had already allowed the passage of vessels carrying Iraqi crude in recent days, according to Reuters.
* Iraq produced about 4 million barrels per day before the Iran war, and virtually all seaborne exports left from the southern Basra terminals in the Persian Gulf, meaning they had to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

* **Qatari spending dramatically reduced by war:** Qatar is [slashing](https://substack.com/redirect/afeb84b0-d101-4a23-a2ff-79c8a491b628?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) spending at home and abroad as the six-month U.S.-Israel war with Iran takes a severe toll on one of the world's richest states, the Financial Times reported.
* Qatari government departments have had budgets reduced by as much as 30%, according to the FT, while funding for overseas aid has been cut by about 85%.
* Qatar has also halted Liquified Natural Gas production, its main source of export revenue, after Iranian strikes damaged the Ras Laffan complex and the war disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
* The International Monetary Fund expects Qatar's economy to contract 8.6% this year, the steepest decline among the six Gulf states. Qatar is leaning on its roughly $500 billion sovereign wealth fund to absorb the shock from the war, but officials are reportedly considering deeper cuts if the crisis continues.

* **U.S. officials claim that 40 tankers crossed Hormuz on Friday; data shows none:** Three U.S. officials [told](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea64148-ef25-46ed-8a49-6442ada3f849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Axios's Barak Ravid on Saturday that 40 tankers crossed the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, carrying 16 million barrels of oil out of the Gulf.
* Kpler's vessel-tracking data, however, showed zero west-to-east tanker crossings on Friday and zero barrels of oil exiting through the Strait.
* **Iranian refinery approaching full repair, official says:** The repair of Iran's South Pars Phase 14 gas refinery, [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/07c1dec6-afab-4981-946c-630bf54c712b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an Israeli strike during the 12-day war in June 2025, is 70% complete, Pars Oil and Gas Company CEO Touraj Dehqani said on Saturday, according to Iran's oil ministry news agency SHANA. Dehqani claimed the refinery would be fully restored and its damaged section reintegrated into the production cycle by year's end.
* South Pars, the offshore field Iran shares with Qatar in the Persian Gulf, is the world's largest gas field and supplies roughly 80% of Iran's natural gas.
* Iran's oil minister also [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/f56d8a37-49b1-46f1-ba38-33c85b9cd4c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the discovery of more than 7.5 trillion cubic feet of natural gas in southern Fars province on Sunday.

* **Pakistan army chief set to visit Iran on Monday:** Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir arrived in Tehran on Monday, according to Iran's Tasnim news agency.
* Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said the trip is part of Pakistan's continuing efforts to strengthen "peace and security" in the region, per New Arab.
* Al Jazeera's Ali Hashem says the meeting is meant to reactivate mediation between the U.S. and Iran.

* **Iran announces it will choke "shuttle" trade through Hormuz:** Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/82186893-db32-4e71-b4d5-9b719bf6ae9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday that any vessel cooperating with a blacklisted ship, including through ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, will be blacklisted and face fines, detention, or confiscation on future Strait of Hormuz passages.
* The move seeks to thwart the workaround that has kept oil moving despite Iran's grip on the strait: a "shuttle" trade in which tankers make short, dark-transit runs through Hormuz with transponders off, then transfer their cargo to other ships via STS just outside the Gulf.
* Energy analysts have said this covert corridor is a major reason global supply hasn't collapsed. U.S. authorities say it is helping move about 8 million barrels daily.

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah targets Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea:** The group's military spokesperson issued a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/561eb732-daa1-4e0b-81dd-d08eefef1b37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) saying an oil tanker belonging to Saudi Arabia "was targeted off the coast of Yanbu in Saudi Arabia with a ballistic missile." Earlier in the day, the UK Maritime Trade Operations said a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile about 63 nautical miles west of Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, causing a fire on the vessel's main deck.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli forces kill two 17-year-old boys, demolish and burn homes across Southern Lebanon despite ceasefire:**
* In Mays Al-Jabal in the Marjayoun district, Israeli bulldozers [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/cc70f680-7b98-48e8-a4e6-65e78960eb06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a temporary school complex in the Dbayeh area, while troops brought in explosives and rigged several homes for demolition, Lebanon's National News Agency reported. In Khiam, forces [blew up](https://substack.com/redirect/9fc47abb-1878-4886-b317-5fc1edad0643?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homes near Al-Mabarrat schools before setting fire to additional homes, properties and agricultural fields.
* The bodies of two 17-year-old boys who had been missing since Sunday were [recovered](https://substack.com/redirect/66b59d06-5bd6-436a-88bd-d68d648d707c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the Dawhat Kfar Remman area in Nabatieh. Lebanon's Health Ministry said they had been killed in an Israeli attack with reports saying an Israeli drone struck the motorcycle they were riding.
* On Saturday, Israeli warplanes struck Ali Al-Taher hill twice, and Israeli artillery hit Dawhat Kfar Remman, Dabsha hill and the wooded area around Ali Al-Taher with phosphorus shells, according to NNA.
* Two additional Israeli airstrikes hit between Sirbin and Rshaf. No injuries were reported in that strike.
* Israeli troops demolished civilian homes in the Zawtar pilot zone; reporting [here](https://substack.com/redirect/a1ece863-234e-44b9-8e47-5d6adbf56fb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from journalist Courtney Bonneau.
* **U.S. envoy walks back comments on Hezbollah role in negotiations:** U.S. envoy Tom Barrack walked back remarks suggesting Hezbollah and Iran should be represented in negotiations surrounding Lebanon. In an interview with Mario Nawfal on Saturday, Barrack [said](https://substack.com/redirect/27d18eaa-adfd-4d60-8da5-6b7a65714259?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that any serious settlement in Lebanon requires Hezbollah and Iran at the negotiating table and the U.S. negotiating team is trying to bring them into the process.
* "The problem is you don't have the people who can make decisions at the table," Barrack told Mario Nawfal. "The people who can make the decision are Hezbollah and Iran."
* On Sunday, however, Barrack told the Associated Press that he had been describing the difficulty of resolving Hezbollah's weapons rather than proposing their participation in negotiations. "Hezbollah is a designated foreign terrorist organization. We do not negotiate with it, and nothing I said suggests otherwise," he said.

# U.S. News
* **Thousands are still without power in northwest Indiana after deadly storms, sparking lawsuit** : More than 28,000 customers [remained](https://substack.com/redirect/2decc493-5dad-472e-8d63-31554bebcd0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) without power as of Sunday in northwest Indiana following storms that began August 11, which killed at least seven people and displaced about 1,000.
* In Gary, a majority-Black city where more than half of residents lost power and about one in three lives in poverty, resident **Shatiya Hardin** described conditions as "absolutely horrible," saying that families are struggling with the heat and that many rely on a community center for meals, air conditioning, and phone charging.
* Indiana Gov. **Mike Braun** requested an expedited major disaster declaration from FEMA for 54 counties, estimating losses could exceed $5 billion.
* **Father of USS Abraham Lincoln sailor detained by ICE while son deployed at sea:** **Luis Manuel Aviles** , a Nicaraguan immigrant who has lived in the U.S. for roughly 20 years, was [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/848c4ce2-d2b4-4a2f-820f-932cb82e37dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Border Patrol during a traffic stop in Key West, Florida, on Saturday, his family said. His son **Joshua Aviles** serves aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed at sea for more than nine months.
* Family members said Aviles had a work permit, Social Security card, and driver's license. There have been more than 50 documented detentions of parents and spouses of active-duty service members during Trump's second term, according to a recent Associated Press investigation.
* **Canada "at war" over trade after U.S.-Canada talks collapse, oil supply squeeze looming for U.S. refiners**: Canadian Prime Minister **Mark Carney** [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/05c7fe6b-88df-4a5a-bbe5-2ee8e7b34368?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Canada "at war" over trade after suspending talks with the U.S., saying President Donald Trump "miscalculated" by demanding a "bad deal" that included new restrictions on Canada's ability to strike trade agreements with other nations and "exclusive access" to Canadian critical minerals.
* The breakdown triggers new tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian exports on top of existing levies on steel, aluminum, lumber, and vehicles, with Carney saying Canada would match the fresh U.S. tariffs "dollar for dollar."
* Separately, U.S. refiners, which are processing the most crude oil in eight years and taking advantage of record diesel margins, face a supply drop from Canada, their largest foreign crude supplier, as planned maintenance in Alberta's oil sands is set to take about 300,000 barrels a day offline next month, according to reporting from Bloomberg.
* **USPS moves forward with mail-in ballot restrictions:** The U.S. Postal Service [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/231c1ae8-9527-4ae7-aab8-f4d172311056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday new eligibility guidelines for mail-in ballots that closely mirror President Donald Trump's March executive order restricting the practice, according to The Hill, even though a federal judge later struck down that order.
* The 95-page report, set for official release August 26, would give states 60 days before the November 3 midterms to notify USPS if they intend to submit citizenship-based voter eligibility lists, echoing Trump's earlier order to the agency.
* U.S. District Judge **Indira Talwani** blocked the order's enforcement earlier this month, warning it would create "confusion" and "chaos" close to the election.
* Nearly a third of 2024 general election ballots were cast by mail, according to a U.S. Election Assistance Commission report.
* **Trump made more than 1,000 stock trades in June, disclosure shows:** President Donald Trump [made](https://substack.com/redirect/3a46a43a-f0cd-4ec4-821c-b733c068d945?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 1,000 securities trades in June, including significant purchases of Berkshire Hathaway, Visa, Mastercard, and Cintas, totaling between $78.1 million and $263.1 million, according to a financial disclosure published Saturday by the U.S. Office of Government Ethics.
* Trump made more than 21,000 securities trades worth between $600 million and $1.86 billion in 2025, often in bursts tied to market-moving events and occasionally involving same-day buying and selling of the same security.
* **Migrants who resisted deportation flight to Liberia forced onward to Equatorial Guinea** : At least five migrants who [refused](https://substack.com/redirect/42279606-cbfb-41a7-8016-0c7c80fe7d2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to get off a U.S. deportation flight in Liberia were instead flown to Equatorial Guinea on Thursday, the New York Times reported.
* Three of the deportees, all Cuban men, told the Times that officers placed knees on their necks while restraining them in Liberia, that they were told they would be returned to the U.S., and that instead they landed in Equatorial Guinea, where they were met by dozens of masked, armed officers and taken to a guarded hotel in the country's capital, Malabo.
* The case is part of a broader deal in which the U.S. approved a $5 million payment to Liberia to accept up to 1,200 deportees.
* **Federal judge strikes down Trump administration 's visa ban on 75 countries**: Judge **Jeannette A. Vargas** of the Southern District of New York [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/5c8d4468-1287-478a-b333-d16fd8fca3cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday that the Trump administration's ban on issuing visas to immigrants from 75 countries was "contrary to law" and exceeded Secretary of State **Marco Rubio 's** legal authority, disputing the administration's stated rationale that targeted immigrants were likely to become "a financial burden to Americans."
* Vargas distinguished the case from the Supreme Court's 2018 upholding of Trump's first-term travel ban, noting that ruling concerned entry restrictions rather than visa issuance.
* The Trump administration is expected to appeal the decision.
* **Jeffries met privately with Kushner amid preparations for possible Democratic House majority:** House Minority Leader **Hakeem Jeffries** [met](https://substack.com/redirect/5c8d4468-1287-478a-b333-d16fd8fca3cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) privately in recent weeks in New York City with **Jared Kushner** , President Trump's top outside adviser and son-in-law, to discuss potential areas of common ground including housing, immigration, and cost of living, The New York Times reported on Saturday.
* Kushner suggested Jeffries meet with White House Chief of Staff **Susie Wiles** , and has reportedly told others that Jeffries is "the most serious person among Democratic leaders" for any bipartisan dealmaking.
* The meeting comes as Trump's inner circle prepares for a possible Democratic House majority, with Jeffries telling the Times last month he has "not ruled anything in and not ruled anything out in terms of accountability," naming War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** as a cabinet official he wants "next on the list" for removal.

# Other International News
* **Israel strikes Syria near the Golan Heights:** Israel [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/3f87f107-917e-44ac-b3c2-59604c6f283f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a drone strike Saturday on a vehicle in Beit Jinn, southwest of Damascus near the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights. The Israeli military said it targeted a man it accused of being in the "final stages" of preparing an imminent attack on Israeli soldiers. Syrian state media said at least one person was wounded and condemned the strike as a violation of Syrian sovereignty.
* The attack came four days after Israel carried out a larger unprovoked aerial bombardment of the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria's northwestern Idlib province on August 18.

* **Barrack suggests Israel bombed Syria 's Abu al-Duhur airbase to "bait" Turkey: **U.S. envoy Tom Barrack [said](https://substack.com/redirect/49ed91c4-b17d-4997-9764-f821aae01ba5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. intelligence found no Turkish military assets at the base and no plan by Ankara to move in, contradicting Netanyahu's justification for Tuesday's attack--and said Turkey was exercising "restraint." He warned Turkey could have scrambled fighter jets against the Israeli aircraft, potentially triggering "World War III." Barrack said another possibility was a "miscommunication" between Netanyahu's office, the Israeli military and Mossad.
* Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz issued a rare Sabbath statement rejecting Barrack's account as "full of inaccuracies." Katz claimed Syria was warned directly, and said Washington was informed beforehand, something Barrack denied.

* **Ukraine strikes Russian refinery, Russians strike Ukrainian mall:** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy [said](https://substack.com/redirect/22a3bb66-df97-447e-a9e2-e1d9f0fa7748?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Saturday that Ukrainian forces had struck Russia's Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery, roughly 1,000 kilometers from the front line, as Kyiv expands its long-range campaign against Russian energy and military infrastructure.
* Ukrainian forces also hit a logistics hub in the Samara region and targets in the Black Sea, according to Zelenskyy.
* Separately, Russian drones struck a busy shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih on Friday evening, killing at least 16 people and injuring more than 130, including 23 children, the Financial Times reports. As of Saturday morning, nine people remained missing, including two children. Twenty-nine victims were in serious condition, among them five children.
* President Volodymyr Zelenskyy [said](https://substack.com/redirect/f73ae4b0-8a5a-4612-8adf-00992438206a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the drones hit in two waves, with the second strike coming about 30 minutes later as emergency crews responded, a "double-tap" attack.
* **Sudanese Army strikes inside of Chad:** The**** Chadian military [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/55e3361a-81ae-4b02-9ffa-ab25d96693c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Saturday that the Sudanese Army conducted a strike on vehicles roughly 100 kilometers into its territory, with reports suggesting the army targeted an RSF convoy traveling through the country.
* Previous reporting has documented similar convoys carrying arms shipments from the UAE through Chad.

* **Venezuela unable to ship oil, Reuters reports:** Venezuela's aging ports have [prevented](https://substack.com/redirect/6c4bebbf-9a59-434c-945e-5106aa9a3d8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it from moving crude oil as quickly as the country is producing and selling it, according to a Reuters report, with tankers waiting up to 30 days to load because of equipment failures, power outages, storage shortages, and crude-quality problems.
* Venezuela has been unable to push exports above roughly 1.25 million barrels per day, despite rising production and strong demand.

* **Embattled Mexican governor Rocha out again:** Sinaloa Gov. Ruben Rocha Moya is [stepping aside](https://substack.com/redirect/7318f627-82ff-417c-b850-caff59dd382c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) again, just a day after returning from leave, following intense pressure from his own party and President Claudia Sheinbaum. Rocha stepped away from office after being accused of drug trafficking and alleged collusion with the Sinaloa Cartel's Chapitos faction by U.S. authorities; he suddenly announced Friday he would return only to then reverse course Saturday, saying he would take an indefinite leave. Morena leaders, including President Sheinbaum, criticized the governor's return as prioritizing personal ambition over party unity and state stability.
* **Germany records over 14,000 heat-related deaths:** Germany registered around 14,000 heat-related deaths this summer amid a series of heatwaves, official data showed, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/a7d45900-ed27-4ecd-82cf-37eae5a1a875?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to AFP. Around 9,600 of those deaths took place in one week in late June when temperatures in Germany rose over 40 degrees Celsius (104 Fahrenheit), according to the Robert Koch Institute, which operates under the Federal Ministry of Health.

* **DR Congo and M23 rebels agree on peace roadmap in Switzerland:** Authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo said in a statement Saturday that the government and the Rwanda-backed M23 rebel group have established a roadmap for peace after five days of negotiations in Switzerland.
* Both sides committed to continuing talks and agreed to create a ceasefire monitoring mechanism, building on the 2025 U.S.-brokered peace framework. A monitoring team is scheduled for its first verification mission in South Kivu's Minembwe region.
* Despite the milestones, Drop Site correspondent [Godfrey Olukya reports](https://substack.com/redirect/e8c40127-b06e-463e-a316-114562042fe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), key disputes persist over detainee releases, political reforms, and sanctions on M23.
* Separately, DR Congo President Joseph Kabila is [challenging](https://substack.com/redirect/5b2db210-735c-41de-8f37-efaf117b2ea7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. sanctions imposed over allegations that he supported the Rwanda-backed M23 rebellion. Kabila filed suit in federal court in Washington, D.C., seeking to overturn Treasury Department sanctions imposed April 30. He was sentenced to death in absentia by a Congolese military court in 2025 over ties to M23.
* **Video shows hundreds held captive after mass abduction from Nigerian mosque:** An armed group released a video [showing](https://substack.com/redirect/e4845078-f2da-459b-ae20-c902972d27d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) what residents said were roughly 600 women, children, and elderly people abducted from a village in north-central Nigeria's Niger State over the weekend.
* Unidentified gunmen attacked worshippers during Friday prayers and simultaneously raided several surrounding communities, witnesses said, carrying the captives into a forest.
* No group has yet claimed responsibility for the attack though ransom kidnappings by criminal groups and extremists is common in the region and the fate of the abductees is presently unknown.

Photo by Scott Olson/Getty Images. Monday, August 24, 2026 - Israeli strikes kill six Palestinians on Monday. Palestinian man executed by Israel in Gaza, family says. Israeli forces kill Palestinian child, settler assaults elderly amputee as attacks continue across the West Bank. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz says Israeli military will act "forcefully" over kites from Gaza. Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad to be detained without charge for months. Hamas tells U.S. envoy Jared Kushner that it will not abide by an unenforced deal. Hamas discusses electoral strategy. "Anti-Netanyahu" says there will be no Palestinian state if he controls government. U.S. to announce "economic D-Day" sanctions against Iran. Iran permits Iraqi tankers to pass through Hormuz. Qatari spending is dramatically reduced by war. U.S. officials claim that 40 tankers crossed Hormuz on Friday; data shows none. Iranian refinery approaching full repair, official says. Pakistan army chief set to visit Iran on Monday. Iran announces it will choke "shuttle" trade through Hormuz. Ansarallah targets Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea. Israeli forces kill two 17-year-old boys, demolish and burn homes across Southern Lebanon despite ceasefire. U.S. envoy walks back comments on Hezbollah role in negotiations. Thousands are still without power in northwest Indiana after deadly storms, sparking lawsuit. Father of USS Abraham Lincoln sailor detained by ICE while son deployed at sea. Canada "at war" over trade after U.S.-Canada talks collapse, oil supply squeeze looming for U.S. refiners. U.S. Postal Service moves forward with mail-in ballot restrictions.
