Independent Dan Osborn is statistically tied with MAGA Senator Pete Ricketts. If Osborn wins, MAGA will lose a seat in the Senate, all but assuring Democrats retake the Senate too.
And a fired up Omaha turnout operation will be key to winning this race too.
That means the blue dot will decide both the fate of the House and the Senate.
That's why the Nebraska Democrats are investing heavily in hitting the pavement in NE-2. But it is one of the largest and most densely packed districts in the entire state. Winning here means real organizing. Door knocking block by block across Omaha neighborhoods to get every Democrat to the polls.
All of this work is labor intensive and expensive, but extremely effective. It's how we'll win this race--or lose, if we aren't capable of fully funding an organizing program capable of reaching the voters we need before November.

clean_body: It is one of just eight districts nationwide that elected a Republican to Congress while also backing Kamala Harris for president. | | | | | == Peter, Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District, home to Omaha, the state's largest city, is a "blue dot" in a red state. It is one of just eight districts nationwide that elected a Republican to Congress while also backing Kamala Harris for president. The Republican incumbent is retiring, leaving an open congressional seat for the first time in a decade. Democratic candidate Denise Powell is running to flip it, facing off against Trump endorsed MAGA extremist and Omaha City Councilman Brinker Harding. Flipping this seat will help get Democrats to the exact math needed to take back the House majority. | == But Nebraska is not just a House battleground this year. Independent Dan Osborn is statistically tied with MAGA Senator Pete Ricketts. If Osborn wins, MAGA will lose a seat in the Senate, all but assuring Democrats retake the Senate too. And a fired up Omaha turnout operation will be key to winning this race too. That means the blue dot will decide both the fate of the House and the Senate. That's why the Nebraska Democrats are investing heavily in hitting the pavement in NE-2. But it is one of the largest and most densely packed districts in the entire state. Winning here means real organizing. Door knocking block by block across Omaha neighborhoods to get every Democrat to the polls. All of this work is labor intensive and expensive, but extremely effective. It's how we'll win this race--or lose, if we aren't capable of fully funding an organizing program capable of reaching the voters we need before November. == | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | Thank you for your support, Jane Kleeb Chairwoman Nebraska Democratic Party | | | == | == | == | Mail checks to: Nebraska Democratic Party 3701 O St. Ste. 200 Lincoln, NE 68510 | PAID FOR BY NEBRASKA DEMOCRATIC PARTY | | | | Nebraska Democrats | 3701 O St Ste. 200 | Lincoln, NE 68510 US | |

body:
This is Trump’s ace in the hole to rig the upcoming midterm elections.
| | | | If you believe you've received this email in error, you may unsubscribe below.

---

---
| Friend,
---
| Late Friday night, **the US Postal Service finalized their plot to effectively ban mail-in ballots** ahead of the November midterm elections. The new finalized rule enacts Trump's March executive order, _an order federal courts have repeatedly blocked._
---
| Under the rule, states must share voter data with the USPS. The USPS then "examines" that data to decide if a voter is eligible for a ballot. If a state refuses to share that sensitive voter data, the USPS won’t deliver ballots in that state.
---
| **This rule would give the Trump admin control over who receives ballots and who doesn’t.**
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012BiWzRczsx1TGOHMgb12BN_-GJ5V-EcLnnLFHxMwyaczGQK-fs1sEVCno_cnhLDmMXUenO-FuUA084bvN6ptkQjnFOgxc9qisoM57Hac88KtztTNtmyno_D5GtO4QJotD_n--KYThvKcSjKBaXUp8NgSuV6pxYwL-HzeyanEuc6dYd_lqkmgkGPGowPe0eYALTPMLJTmoob02Q530mT1LnJgRVocIvkt21fvsqwKJ1rW_vjq5A0_Xg-p8QOSvo0JmcpHEOYFyGq8kINjJuQEvQ==&c=PrZTammZfQr9XT3DCTt8ZjSvOopTVhEkXlrVlXDVFn3l4OY6mueZjw==&ch=vTRVRzZ0qIoksi73KOifbio89hUE2SNzIt5I1T0BqzbAJBydFOU4jQ==)
---
| _We do not have to imagine how Trump uses this power._ Live in a heavily Democratic area? _No ballot._ Have a name that sounds Black or Hispanic? _No ballot._ They are not hiding what this is.
---
| **This is Trump’s ace in the hole to rig the upcoming midterm elections.**
---
| If you have been following our work, you know the Constitution gives states, not the federal government, the responsibility for administering elections. **But the Trump admin is betting that the MAGA-occupied Supreme Court will let this rule stand anyway.**
---
| In its Friday filing, the Postal Service said it would "not take actions to implement the rule specifically for the 2026 election" unless SCOTUS rules in the administration's favor, and the Justice Department told the court it would wait for that ruling before moving forward.
---
| _And that’s where it gets scary._**W****e have seen how partisan SCOTUS has become.** They overturned Roe. They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They handed Trump criminal immunity. This court has been fully exposed as a puppet of Trump and MAGA extremists. **And they are expected to issue a ruling on this exact rule any day now.**
---
| **This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists.** We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
---
| [Free and fair elections are under attack. Will you join the over 100,000 Democrats who have joined our cause by rushing a contribution of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare before to help us fight Trump’s election rigging attempts this November?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012BiWzRczsx1TGOHMgb12BN_-GJ5V-EcLnnLFHxMwyaczGQK-fs1sEVCno_cnhLDmIMWE6ABfcwfuYvWl2d7pYOGVKNR6HTTd2_2oqdyeFmA3OlbWVXN1W0kahEjxxFGiCF1rmPNLsTqSBUrQt2bbFUYUGJwpvUlsLwMAb4IlmJ7pJ2wBXVYlcoUPNyj3NuvfeSana5tnqyrElLz4qVIpca8ZnBN8Fx8wdnieYmtXK3mk9pfTzMx3TfHc6otpoO3pulQwtIZ9zqH-HTzmFMt2tA==&c=PrZTammZfQr9XT3DCTt8ZjSvOopTVhEkXlrVlXDVFn3l4OY6mueZjw==&ch=vTRVRzZ0qIoksi73KOifbio89hUE2SNzIt5I1T0BqzbAJBydFOU4jQ==)****

| | Friend,
Our investigation into Dr. Fauci's government-issued phone is only just beginning, and I wanted you to hear the details directly from me.
My subcommittee, working alongside Senator Rand Paul's committee, has obtained a copy of Fauci's government iPhone from HHS. Here's what we've found so far:
✅ **More than 34,000 text messages**
✅ **522 voicemails**
✅ **Records spanning from 2014 to just days before Fauci left the NIH**
✅ **_And only 3 saved contacts, with nearly every other message tied only to a raw phone number, not a name_**
That last detail matters.
_When almost none of your correspondents are saved as actual contacts, despite tens of thousands of messages, it raises a simple question: was that an accident, or by design?_
I want to be clear about how we're handling this: this isn't going to be a document dump. We're reviewing this material carefully, working to protect the privacy of unrelated individuals, and coordinating releases with Senator Paul's team. But where the public has a right to know, we will not sit on it. **_Transparency is always the goal._**
This comes on the heels of Fauci pleading the Fifth Amendment 111 times before Congress, and the committee vote that followed to hold him in contempt. Now we have his own words and his own messages, and we intend to go through every one of them.

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,If you live in Johnson County, you should have received your Revenue Neutral Rate notice by now. And already, we're hearing the familiar line:**“We aren't raising the mill levy, so we aren't raising taxes.”** Let's make one thing clear: **A flat mill rate does NOT mean flat property taxes.** Your property tax is driven by two things: your property's assessed value and the mill rate. When values rise and the mill rate stays flat, the county collects more property-tax revenue.That's exactly why Kansas has a **Revenue Neutral Rate.** It tells us what mill rate would allow the county to collect the same amount of property-tax revenue as the year before. As valuations grow, that rate generally falls.**The current County Commission is proposing to keep the mill rate flat rather than lowering it to the Revenue Neutral Rate.** So yes, they can say they aren't raising the mill rate. **But they don't have to raise the rate to collect more of your money.** Commissioners don't control the real estate market. They DO control **the county budget** and mill levy.The question isn't simply:**“Did you raise the mill rate?”** It's:**“How much more property-tax revenue are you collecting, and what are taxpayers getting for it?”** A flat mill rate is not a tax freeze.**Watch the dollars, not just the rate.** As County Commission Chair, my number one priority will be to rein in unnecessary spending and deliver real property-tax relief, not simply celebrate a flat mill levy while taxpayers continue paying more.In order to fulfill this promise, I have to win the election. Mike Kelly is campaigning on the status quo. We deserve better than that. Help me fight and win to bring fiscal responsibility and real property-tax relief.Every $25, $50, $100, or $250 contribution helps us reach another voter, put another sign in the ground, send another piece of mail, and make the case for a different direction in Johnson County.[**DONATE HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/Q6MvQIGjE7_?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494) And money alone will not win this election.We are building an army of supporters who believe Johnson County deserves transparent leadership, fiscal sanity, accountability, and a government that remembers whose money it is spending.Knock doors. Make calls. Host a gathering. Put up a sign. Talk to your neighbors.[**JOIN THE TEAM**](https://us.list-manage.com/186TUUemB6u?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494) I promise to fight to bring about positive change. **Are you ready to join me?****P.S. - Join ME tomorrow night at the Johnson County Revenue Neutral Meeting at the Olathe Conference Center, 10401 S Ridgeview Rd, Olathe, KS 66061, 6:00 PM start time. See you there!** Respectfully,
Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

Help me fight and win to bring fiscal responsibility and real property-tax relief.Every $25, $50, $100, or $250 contribution helps us reach another voter, put another sign in the ground, send another piece of mail, and make the case for a different direction in Johnson County. Make calls. Host a gathering. Put up a sign. Talk to your neighbors. I promise to fight to bring about positive change. body:
#

Hi, it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to share this message from Michigan’s Democratic nominee for Senate, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. Abdul is running in one of the most competitive Senate races this November, and his election could decide whether we can win back a gun safety majority. Take a minute to read it, then consider splitting a donation between his campaign and GIFFORDS PAC today.
* * *

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-sayed-split-partner_ms_aes_em_giff.lom7Nw&refcode=em260824-1-b&t=1&akid=11757%2E3935704%2EP5f3gf)
---
Hello, it's Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. I am so proud to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan. And now, our general election campaign officially begins.
Sixteen months ago, this campaign launched with a handful of us in a room and one belief: it shouldn't be this hard, in the richest country in the world, to see a doctor, pay your bills, or know your kids will have it better than you did.
**We carried that to every corner of the state. Now there's one job left: beat MAGA Mike Rogers and win a seat that could decide our Senate majority.**
Rogers got a head start. While we fought through an expensive primary, he ran unopposed, with Trump's backing and $51 million in spending building him up. And still, the race is tied. A recent poll has it locked at 45% to 45%.
**This seat is there for us to take. The only question is whether we reach voters before their money does.**
[**Will you split one of the very first donations of our general election between our campaign and GIFFORDS PAC? A dollar right now buys the ads that define these races. A dollar in October only answers their attacks. There is no better time to invest than the start.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/65324?c0=giff-em-sayed-split-partner_ms_aes_em_giff.bjA9ZP&refcode=em260824-1-b&t=2&akid=11757%2E3935704%2EP5f3gf)
**[SPLIT A DONATION](https://go.giffords.org/go/65324?c0=giff-em-sayed-split-partner_ms_aes_em_giff.bjA9ZP&refcode=em260824-1-b&t=3&akid=11757%2E3935704%2EP5f3gf)**
Here's the contrast in this race.
I'm a doctor. Mike Rogers is the guy who introduced the bill that helped Big Pharma flood this country with opioids. More than 600,000 Americans died. He never apologized. Then he took $400,000 from the drug companies that profited.
As Detroit's health director, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders. Rogers spent 30 years in Washington, and left up to $14 million richer working for the same corporations he used to regulate.
I trust women to make their own decisions. Rogers voted for a national abortion ban, including one with no exceptions for rape or incest.

Moments ago, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states.

|
Peter,
Moments ago, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states.
For some context, earlier this Summer Trump called on dozens of blue states across the country to share their voter data with the administration. When they declined Trump initiated a process to have the USPS revoke their ability to use mail-in ballots.
For months, lower courts held the line preventing Trump from carrying out the order. Today that changed. Trump is now on the cusp of making true on his threat to blue states that if they do not hand over sensitive voter data they can't use mail-in ballots.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FonZZAoO6bLlaULSEYbQZC_xliWXAsz3kDiW8FUM7Xckty3v6mZ8DZDlcHkJ0idXOcNmKno11IcVO1riww8eu9seFxukhuJPMQ_2KiuICnRbA1ygW0-tvPKmsnrNh_T6IPmD0PaPq2W4zMaPtS1BE2Gf2Rx4Pl7kh9rBpKGps9AS5zgZMvy9Eg7X_HldZ8ZzgIQye2Q1CwW1ifMs39Kk1JlrcuY5SIAxIto6J4r-O8pyub_NNA_8tw==&c=AOsr0_3pamG06CryQqWLVkuGhqlFshRJj6i8hqte-MQB_4zn8M6vUQ==&ch=oWNmVSTLMzPlKhtMuqIfRxGTyTGOuTZ0WGYWAVBzLjdcSsiGrsK93g==)
---
Blue states are rightfully declining to share their voter list with the White House because sharing them would give MAGA the names and addresses of every Democratic voter.
The reasons why MAGA wants these names and addresses are two fold:
In the short term it will help MAGA rig elections by knowing exactly whose ballots to challenge and throw out. But the long term is far more disturbing. It lets the administration and aligned far-right paramilitary groups know where every Democrat lives.
No governor in their right mind would go along with handing over that data so what this means is that blue state voters will soon no longer have the right to vote by mail.
All that stands in the way of the ban's full implementation is an injunction that is hanging by a thread, and the possibility that a Massachusetts judge could block the ban as soon as tomorrow. But these fights will land back in the Supreme Court too. And let's not fool ourselves, we know exactly how this court packed with right-wing extremists will rule.
This is why Defend Our Courts mission is now more important than ever. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
This is it. The nightmare scenario is now a reality. [We need to make this election too big to rig and save our Democracy. clean_body: Moments ago, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states. | | | | | == | Peter, Moments ago, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states. For some context, earlier this Summer Trump called on dozens of blue states across the country to share their voter data with the administration. When they declined Trump initiated a process to have the USPS revoke their ability to use mail-in ballots. For months, lower courts held the line preventing Trump from carrying out the order. Today that changed. Trump is now on the cusp of making true on his threat to blue states that if they do not hand over sensitive voter data they can't use mail-in ballots. | == Blue states are rightfully declining to share their voter list with the White House because sharing them would give MAGA the names and addresses of every Democratic voter. The reasons why MAGA wants these names and addresses are two fold: In the short term it will help MAGA rig elections by knowing exactly whose ballots to challenge and throw out. But the long term is far more disturbing. It lets the administration and aligned far-right paramilitary groups know where every Democrat lives. No governor in their right mind would go along with handing over that data so what this means is that blue state voters will soon no longer have the right to vote by mail. All that stands in the way of the ban's full implementation is an injunction that is hanging by a thread, and the possibility that a Massachusetts judge could block the ban as soon as tomorrow. But these fights will land back in the Supreme Court too. And let's not fool ourselves, we know exactly how this court packed with right-wing extremists will rule. This is why Defend Our Courts mission is now more important than ever. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration. This is it. **NH Dems get a Consolation Prize in Pete Buttigieg**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** August 24th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

**CONCORD, N.H.** — New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement in response to the announcement by New Hampshire Democratic Party that former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg will headline its Eleanor Roosevelt Dinner:“Pete Buttigieg was a bad Mayor, a dangerously awful Transportation Secretary, and will be a horrible Presidential candidate,” said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie. “The DNC stole the First-in-the-Nation Primary from New Hampshire, and now their consolation prize to New Hampshire Democrats is dumping Pete Buttigieg on their marquee dinner. It speaks to how little national Democrats think of New Hampshire voters.”“Granite Staters haven't forgotten his record as Transportation Secretary. From the [holiday travel meltdown](https://gop.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6abc8216f2c93cdbede56dda3&id=d0fc6d5e0d&e=f3aa6419cd) that stranded millions of travelers to an EV charging program that fell [far behind schedule](https://gop.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6abc8216f2c93cdbede56dda3&id=6f836c14e0&e=f3aa6419cd), Buttigieg left behind a disastrous record.”“Chris Pappas supported the same agenda in Congress. Now, Pappas wants a promotion to the United States Senate, and New Hampshire Democrats are bringing in another failed national Democrat in the hopes that he can boost Pappas’ chances in November.”###

| | |

Friends,

For years, Liberty University was essentially told "no" on a Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program. When I was elected, I told Liberty University we would get it done, through teamwork, persistence, and putting our military first.

Today, on my birthday, I had the honor of going to the Pentagon and meeting with Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao to finalize and sign the contract that makes it official.

This agreement will allow Liberty University to establish a cross-town Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program with the University of Virginia beginning this school year. Liberty University students will now have the opportunity to train, serve, and become officers in the United States Navy and Marine Corps, strengthening our military and giving more young Americans a clear path to lead.

Hey, In the last debate of this campaign, Senator Markey admitted he doesn't know which “companies his iPad might be using” when asked if he uses AI – and claimed there’s “no difference” between Siri and advanced AI like Claude. 20-year tax breaks for data centers and rising costs for Texas families.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Peter, Greg Abbott gave data centers the richest taxpayer handouts of any state in the country. He invited them all into Texas, and now there's a gold rush.**
In 2015, Abbott signed a law giving data centers a 20-year tax break –**while Texas families struggle with rising costs, these billion-dollar corporations get a free pass on billions in taxes.**
Communities across the state are feeling the consequences. Data centers are draining our power grid, driving up electricity costs, and consuming massive amounts of water.
Abbott is the sole person who can end this madness. He has the power to call a special session, to put a moratorium on new data center tax breaks, and to give power back to the people of Texas.
**But he hasn't. And he won't.**
Because he's financially benefiting. He’s made **$20 million** from data center developers.
Texans deserve a governor who puts people before corporations – a governor who will protect our power grid, our water supply, and our communities. The people of Texas should have a say on if and how data centers are welcomed into our neighborhoods.
I'm not taking a dime from data center developers. I'm not giving away 20-year tax breaks to billionaires. _I'm fighting for you._

**Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote.** So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead and with only weeks to go before the midterms. The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. **That's why Trump continues to call for its passage** , trying to add it to multiple other bills. Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now **targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters**.We're kicking our efforts to register voters ahead of the midterms into high gear. The math is simple:
---
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we could register 10,000 new voters➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and this work can truly impact 2026's elections
---
**Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful**.**[Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137840275/642119098/-331524135?refcode=082426_2&amount=36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRlYzk0YmIxLWVmOWYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JqA96lXpaR8G-RDxWZ5ReWTY5FyWLc2VhQG3OU6o4TM=)**
---
[ **GIVE $36 RIGHT NOW ➜** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137840276/642119099/-578618637?express_lane=true&refcode=082426_2&amount=36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRlYzk0YmIxLWVmOWYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JqA96lXpaR8G-RDxWZ5ReWTY5FyWLc2VhQG3OU6o4TM=)

clean_body: I need your help to finish what we started. | We're almost to the finish line, Fellow Patriot, but we cannot slow down yet, because I need your help. We're behind where we should be, even though we've accomplished so much in just over 30 days. Just over four weeks ago, I officially got into this race. Less than two weeks ago, voters in South Carolina cast their votes for the Primary Special Election. Now, I am asking for your help AGAIN to help us win this Runoff Election. I am not a politician - and I think that's a good thing. My opponent has had 20 years to build up his campaign war chest. I have not. What I do have is almost thirty years of working for the people of South Carolina, the values Lindsey and I were both raised on, Every dollar we raise between now and when polls close tomorrow matters now more than ever. It helps us compete with the millions my opponent has put into this race. Our campaign wouldn't be here without the grassroots support of people like you. Right now, I need you with me more than ever. Together, Ayanna and I have introduced policies to strengthen HUD tenant protections and ban facial recognition technology in public and assisted housing.
Early in the pandemic, we passed a policy to send funding to states and local governments responding to unhoused people’s needs.
And this year we re-introduced the _Housing FIRST Act_ — which would remove unjust barriers and help people who are formerly incarcerated and those with criminal histories to access safe and stable housing. subject: The most competitive district this election cycle

body:

Gas prices are at record highs, inflation is at a three-year peak, and Latino families across the country are feeling it _every single day._

James Carville -- the Ragin' Cajun, a Louisiana political legend -- just said something that should make every Democrat in America sit up and pay attention:
The Louisiana Senate race is now on his WATCH LIST.
After Jamie Davis's dominant first-place finish in the primary -- 47% with no political machine, no big money, just grassroots fire -- Carville sees what we've been saying all along:
Louisiana is WINNABLE.
And Carville knows what he's talking about. The man helped flip Louisiana blue when everyone said it was impossible. He understands this state's politics better than just about anyone alive.
Jamie Davis is the lone Democrat in this race who can WIN this seat and flip it into Democratic hands. Not just compete -- WIN.
A third-generation farmer. Grandson of a sharecropper. The authentic, no-nonsense, people-focused candidate who just proved he can turn out Black voters, women voters, and working-class voters in numbers Louisiana hasn't seen in decades.
The Republican side is a complete disaster. Two MAGA candidates tearing each other apart, fighting to prove loyalty to a president whose approval is tanking. Trump's toxic. Their message is stale. And Democrats are FIRED UP.
The pieces are in place. The momentum is real. James Carville sees it.
Now we need to prove him right.
But winning this seat isn't going to happen on momentum alone. We need resources. We need organization. We need a grassroots army that can go toe-to-toe with MAGA's money machine.
Carville put us on the watch list. Now let's give him -- and the entire country -- something to watch.

_**by Cliff Schecter and Lawrence Winnerman**_
John Cornyn was not going to lose a primary. Four terms, thirty years in Texas politics, the Republican establishment's establishment. Ken Paxton beat him on May 26.
Bill Cassidy was not going to lose either. He finished third in Louisiana's jungle primary and went home.
Steve Daines was not going to walk away from a seat he had already filed to defend, with $4.9 million banked. On March 4, at roughly 5:58 in the evening, two minutes before Montana's filing deadline closed, he withdrew from his reelection campaign.
McConnell's seat is open. So are Joni Ernst's, Tommy Tuberville's, Cynthia Lummis', Markwayne Mullin's (it feels like there should be two seats open for that name), and Thom Tillis'. Nine of the twenty-two Republican-held seats on this year's ballot have no incumbent running.
Every one of those sentences was near impossible to imagine saying eighteen months ago. All of them are now facts.

* * *
## The Wrong Math
A map is circulating that shows fifty-seven Democrats, three independents, and forty Republicans. Sixty votes--the number that breaks a filibuster under Senate Rule XXII, without anyone abolishing anything.
Watch how people dismiss it. They take the ten Republican seats the map needs, assign each one a 20 percent chance, multiply, and arrive at something like one in ten million. Then they go back to talking about the four seats that get you to fifty-one.
That is the wrong math, and it is not a close call.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a92426bb-e8e6-4f63-89ad-a8d9c5e5c285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Senate races are not ten independent coin flips. They are ten measurements of the same underlying thing, and when that thing moves, they move together. Nate Silver's midterm model is built on exactly this premise: race outcomes, he writes, "are somewhat correlated," and some years produce "systemic bias in the forecast rather than variance in individual races." A 2018 study in the _Journal of the American Statistical Association_ put a number on it--average polling error of roughly 3.5 points, twice what reported margins of error imply, and shared by every poll in a race rather than scattered among them.
Which means the distribution has a fat tail, and the fat tail is where sixty lives. If the national environment runs two points better than the polls say, it runs two points better in Kansas and South Carolina and Florida at the same time.
Nobody has to win ten separate lottery tickets. One number has to be wrong in one direction--and that number is wrong, in one direction or the other, in almost every cycle. Having begun my career in this crazy business at two different polling firms, I've seen this happen more times than you can imagine, and I'm seeing some things you won't believe--and that even I am having trouble processing. But they sure are consistent in states as diverse as Ohio, Idaho, Iowa, and Texas.
##### **The rest of this is the map.**
##### Which ten seats. Which three independents. The 31.8-point swing Democrats already produced this year -- bigger than Trump's 2024 margin in Florida, Kansas, South Carolina, Montana, Nebraska, and Arkansas.

Jerri is a lifelong Tennessean, a mom of three, an educator, and a former public defender who has spent her life showing up for working families across Tennessee.
Having lived in Memphis, Knoxville, and Nashville, Jerri knows firsthand the beauty, the struggles, and the deep values that define every corner of our state. And unlike the current power-hungry Republicans who have plagued our state with rising costs, chaos, and corruption for far too long, Jerri actually has a proven track record of delivering results for working families:
* **Supporting Mothers & Families:** She directly improved maternal healthcare in Tennessee by securing funding for Black midwife fellows.
* **Fighting for Fair Wages:** She fought for and successfully raised wages for Shelby County employees to a real, living wage.
* **Keeping Communities Safe:** She launched Tennessee’s first-ever free gun lock-by-mail program to help protect our kids and our neighborhoods.
* **Advocating for the Vulnerable:** As a former public defender and Memphis City Councilor, she has spent her entire career standing up to powerful interests to protect everyday people.

Jerri is running to bring some real grit to the Governor’s office, fully fund our public schools, expand healthcare, protect reproductive freedom, and build a Tennessee where all of us can belong and thrive.
**They call her "One Tough Mother,” and she is ready to take that energy to the Governor’s office.**

subject: Don't Let Billionaires and Super PACs Pick Our Next President

body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Imagine this: the presidential race is in full swing, but before you’ve
even had a chance to cast a ballot in the Democratic primary, your
favorite candidate has already been sidelined — not by voters, but by
torrents of billionaire-funded super PAC spending.

We don’t have to imagine it. New reports just showed that already, $1.6
BILLION has poured into the midterms to try to buy the outcome. AIPAC and
its network of billionaire donors dumped tens of millions into Michigan’s
Senate primary to try to take down Abdul El-Sayed. And they’re using the
same tricks against progressives across the country.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1011&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]Headline: Meet the megadonors pouring more than $1.6 billion into the
2026 elections

If we don’t act, it won’t stop there.

That’s why we’re calling on the DNC to ban super PAC and dark money
spending in Democratic presidential primaries.

Our Revolution already fought for and won a party Resolution vowing to do
just that — but now the establishment is fighting to stop the DNC from
taking the next step: passing a real, enforceable plan. While they work to
keep the super PAC money flowing, we need thousands of signatures to show
DNC leaders that the base is watching RIGHT NOW.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1012&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]Tell the DNC: Ban Super PAC Money in Democratic Primaries Now!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1013&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]ADD YOUR NAME

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1014&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]Graphic reading: TELL THE DNC: BAN DARK & CORPORATE MONEY FROM
PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARIES.

If we don’t get this dark money ban, AIPAC, Crypto, AI, and other special
interests will decide who represents us in 2028 — they’ll influence the
Democratic primary then pivot back to throwing money at Republicans like
J.D. Vance or Marco Rubio in the general election.

We need to prevent this by acting NOW. And our best chance is by banning
super PACs in our presidential primaries. Our Revolution helped elect
progressives inside the DNC itself who are fighting to make this reality —
but the establishment is pushing back. Now is the time to flood the DNC
with public pressure for party leaders to act.

As Our Revolution’s founding chair Larry Cohen said, “This would be the
most significant reform since getting superdelegates off the first
ballot.” Now we need to make it happen.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1015&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]Tell the DNC: Ban Super PACs and dark money from picking our next
Democratic presidential nominee.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39568?source=email-20260824&t=1016&akid=11226%2E5885482%2EiBSZ8o ]ADD YOUR NAME

The establishment is fighting tooth and nail for their donors’ interests.
But this decision could come down in a matter of weeks. Now is the time to
make our voices impossible to ignore, so the DNC knows the Democratic base
stands for democracy, not the highest bidder.

Help us make history — and ensure the next Democratic nominee is chosen by
people like us, not billionaires.

When we organize, we win.

Lead Story · Foreign PolicyBESSENT SET TO UNVEIL SWEEPING IRAN SANCTIONS AS TEHRAN THREATENS TO RETALIATEWhat's Happening
* Treasury Secretary **Scott Bessent** is expected to announce a large wave of sanctions targeting Iran's economy on Monday, in a push the administration has branded an **"economic D-Day."**
* **Mohsen Rezaei** of Iran's Supreme National Security Council vowed Tehran will retaliate in a **"seismic"** manner to any sanctions.
* Rezaei wrote on X that Iran "will regard any country's participation in or support for America's economic war against the Iranian people as an act of war," and warned that if the economic war continues, no oil will be exported through the Strait of Hormuz or anywhere in the Persian Gulf.

The Situation
* Iranian President **Masoud Pezeshkian** called Sunday for a return to the Memorandum of Understanding, saying it is better than the current condition of "neither war nor peace."
* Fox News reported **no attacks on vessels** in the Strait of Hormuz over the prior 48 hours, but traffic through the strait remains down.
* Senate Majority Whip **John Barrasso** (R-WY) discussed the escalating standoff and the coming sanctions on Fox's "Sunday Morning Futures."
* Important caveat: as of Monday morning the package had **not been formally announced**. The specific targets, scope, and enforcement mechanisms are still to come from Treasury.

The PerspectiveChoosing the checkbook over the bomb bay is the right instinct, and it deserves to be said plainly: economic pressure risks no American lives, and a regime that cannot pay its proxies cannot project power. But sanctions are a tool, not a strategy, and the honest history is mixed — Tehran has absorbed enormous economic pain before without changing its behavior. The measure of this policy is whether it produces a verifiable deal or merely a longer siege. And Rezaei's threat to close the Persian Gulf is a reminder that the bill for this fight can arrive at an American gas pump. Voters will judge the result, not the announcement.[Read the full story at Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_N8M2yF9-VjcaxkG0L0zQSVIJ1shdNTmF84C3E8OKrQ0xxRpuhpzQ-BXA_mPmbaO0DPFK-vBQTex8sLKjKkCxvVV1nw4db5Dyvk8SQ_JZ4UFHM1KIWkBLq1KkcHaBNriWHs75NpYLTvaExCMdrEKltl_I7PIMCLn6N0bnjRJlRaHJVdhAnO7_j9FlUkWcnVejyIbyxxofAaHeqSRDIw8qHtWtlGN14USjK6jTNmiGXiIlfNGQ4TE2luJNYSOXJsHJhyZDuwFIvov20URFRG6YQHWe9MwDu2ZCzKezQ-oiAd7X2hKaIYmpqu0kC2Y3jmYvh89RQpCluHgQgpBiICNy1U/4tg/KnXPMjsqTiGPMUVuFutBtA/h5/h001.uGhxLwuamgTU0kKkcAWIRt-n7PRYppGXdl729WnsZ4g)

TradeCANADA ANSWERS 50% U.S. TARIFFS WITH DOLLAR-FOR-DOLLAR RETALIATIONWhat's Happening
* U.S.-Canada trade talks collapsed Friday evening, and the administration's **50% tariffs took effect at midnight Saturday** on Canadian goods including automobiles, dairy, alcohol, and hockey sticks.
* Prime Minister **Mark Carney** announced Canada will match Washington "dollar for dollar," with retaliatory duties taking force **Sept. 8** — the Tuesday after Labor Day.
* Canada's countermeasures will target steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics, plus goods covered by U.S. Section 232 and 338 actions.

The Situation
* Carney said he pulled Canada's negotiators from Washington after U.S. envoys made "last-minute changes" to the framework; the administration says Ottawa walked away from terms both sides had agreed to earlier in the week.
* Carney sharpened his language considerably: "We were attacked — like you're at war when you get attacked. We got attacked."
* U.S. Trade Representative **Jamieson Greer** told Fox's "Fox & Friends Weekend" that no new talks are planned, and named Canada and China as the only two countries that have retaliated against U.S. tariffs.
* Worth flagging: the Washington Examiner put the value of affected Canadian imports at about **$28 billion** , while NBC News, citing the U.S. Trade Representative's office, reported roughly **$20 billion**. The figures have not been reconciled.

The PerspectiveLeverage only works if the other side blinks, and Ottawa just declined to. That is the part of the tariff argument conservatives should be willing to say out loud: a duty is a tax collected at the border and paid downstream, and a retaliation spiral means American farmers and manufacturers pay it too. There is a serious case for using tariffs to reshore critical production and to force partners into fairer terms — but the case rests on getting to a deal, and Greer says there are no talks scheduled. Two weeks remain before Canada's measures bite. Using them to reopen negotiations would be worth more than another round of press releases.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWslDrlWqxLOtIy7S3gUPIAAkvsi-kMt9GII4in0QIXtPNC-8TTZs_11X9TZtxR5ss9mvi3M0kDbM5MH0Im2ea28Y6_2ihTjrY0MlAGyQhedw4t6XRJ8jVJqZk7Bq5mbiCSf96HV2MCTiOezkxhjbtoJCvP185UgciRHqKmE-v3GDUAN8pItNolz6g8rN5rK1vcNq5VsJWNN9nODq7XS4i7bfD93CruO6JXbFsaBaUq_XNN3Dreu-ZmNF-fbxLNleVyA7UWcl4eigqI0wTNX9VtC2w7G4yZh9_CabPsQpNR6osrEEBEgnokKlXtSCMBhmlbnCjkac-rgXzcIJfwlffA/4tg/KnXPMjsqTiGPMUVuFutBtA/h6/h001.Ths12p72OhbHUfSYHWlu18jdyjMWIPz3q11D55qVUVE)

CongressJEFFRIES AND KUSHNER MET PRIVATELY IN NEW YORK TO HUNT FOR COMMON GROUNDWhat's Happening
* House Minority Leader **Hakeem Jeffries** (D-NY) and **Jared Kushner** , the president's son-in-law and informal adviser, met privately in New York City, according to a New York Times report published Sunday.
* The two discussed **housing, immigration, and cost of living** as potential areas of common ground between House Democrats and the administration.
* Kushner reportedly suggested Jeffries meet with White House chief of staff **Susie Wiles** as a way to get the president's attention.

The Situation
* The meeting space was arranged by a mutual friend; a source told the Times the two men were catching up. They previously worked together on criminal justice legislation during Trump's first term.
* Jeffries, in a statement to the Times: "In every conversation that we have with the Trump administration, we will continue to make it explicitly clear that the affordability crisis is not a hoax, and nothing short of transformational policy change is acceptable."
* Republicans hold narrow majorities in both chambers. If Democrats retake the House in November, Jeffries would be first in line to replace Speaker **Mike Johnson** (R-LA).
* Caveat: the underlying account comes from the Times citing sources familiar with the meeting. Beyond Jeffries's written statement, neither man has publicly described what was said.

The PerspectiveTwo people who disagree about most things sitting down to find the few things they don't is how a legislature is supposed to work, and the First Step Act is proof it can produce something. The interesting detail is not that they met — it's the agenda. Housing, immigration, and the cost of living are the three items voters keep naming, and both sides evidently know it. Republicans should not read that as a trap. If the GOP has the better answer on prices, it should want the argument out in the open, not conducted through press releases. The MilitaryNAVY WEIGHS RENAMING THE CARRIER HONORING PEARL HARBOR HERO DORIS MILLERWhat's Happening
* Navy leadership has discussed renaming an aircraft carrier now under construction — designated the **USS Doris Miller** — after President Trump, two U.S. officials told NBC News.
* Those officials said the discussion has been **ongoing for several months**.
* Ship-naming authority rests with the Navy secretary, though defense secretaries are typically closely involved in carrier decisions — meaning the call would fall to Defense Secretary **Pete Hegseth** and acting Navy Secretary **Hung Cao**.

The Situation
* Doris Miller was a mess attendant at Pearl Harbor who manned an anti-aircraft gun he had never been trained on, is credited with downing at least one Japanese aircraft, and pulled wounded sailors to safety.
* He became the **first Black service member awarded the Navy Cross** , the Navy's second-highest decoration.
* The carrier was named for Miller during Trump's first term; it would be the first carrier named for a Black American and for an enlisted sailor.
* Caveat: **no decision has been announced**. The reporting rests on two unnamed officials, and NBC News said the Navy did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The PerspectiveNothing has been decided, and it should stay that way. Doris Miller is not a diversity gesture — he is a mess attendant who ran toward gunfire, worked a weapon nobody had let him train on, and carried wounded men out of the fire on a morning when the country needed exactly that. Honoring him is not identity politics; it is the oldest conservative instinct there is, which is that valor outranks rank. This administration named that ship for him, and that was a good decision then and now. There is also a plain republican case, small "r," against putting a living politician's name on a warship at all — a tradition both parties have chipped away at and both parties should restore. Let the ship be the Doris Miller.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Hww93iPI4LJrShhMJMeWsC4Cn5VR7q44ZTE_T9Vci_WtV5C8qF1ZplVYwxXMPxFRcnblaZ-fcxy3fwB9x-7ccONph4GpWw6noI3fmfcioIUB20jeux5AC9GfXyBVqXUETBhv5C2cqT_hbqg7VueBHjORKlotRRMo9jUjMS05VJCFBS81ZZNI9hzN--Nf9B-BjkVoDISkLaNVjCiQBHreahJ-7wW7-m6tpqV-3GNak71AUCF22evWzZboXL4KJxhY4K5JE-7ioaifiFfB1z1ufp2uwSQ8D_nCGjqZPZjk2dVy4gH-jNUiWI8DKTyhSo33ChwrEf-Z9pvRpyCiulh6zCDGJnM9WvRH5viLdidTnM0m69RFsSYwNOY4K8R31ffQLyHLovHSowAYYNTuBlFk54/4tg/KnXPMjsqTiGPMUVuFutBtA/h8/h001.2GZpry2bk1yNouHT_erDJRLNFHGQw3ezAXX8CQ5KGdY)

Washington is preparing to squeeze Tehran without firing a shot, and Tehran is threatening the shipping lane that sets the price of a gallon of gas. Ottawa was supposed to fold and instead matched us dollar for dollar. And in a quiet room in New York, the two parties' most pragmatic operators were talking about housing and grocery bills, because that is what everybody already knows the November argument is about. Canada's countermeasures will target steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics, plus goods covered by U.S. Section 232 and 338 actions. The Situation Carney said he pulled Canada's negotiators from Washington after U.S. envoys made "last-minute changes" to the framework; the administration says Ottawa walked away from terms both sides had agreed to earlier in the week. Carney sharpened his language considerably: "We were attacked — like you're at war when you get attacked. We got attacked." U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told Fox's "Fox & Friends Weekend" that no new talks are planned, and named Canada and China as the only two countries that have retaliated against U.S. tariffs. Worth flagging: the Washington Examiner put the value of affected Canadian imports at about $28 billion , while NBC News, citing the U.S. Trade Representative's office, reported roughly $20 billion. The figures have not been reconciled. The PerspectiveLeverage only works if the other side blinks, and Ottawa just declined to. That is the part of the tariff argument conservatives should be willing to say out loud: a duty is a tax collected at the border and paid downstream, and a retaliation spiral means American farmers and manufacturers pay it too. There is a serious case for using tariffs to reshore critical production and to force partners into fairer terms — but the case rests on getting to a deal, and Greer says there are no talks scheduled. Two weeks remain before Canada's measures bite. Using them to reopen negotiations would be worth more than another round of press releases. CongressJEFFRIES AND KUSHNER MET PRIVATELY IN NEW YORK TO HUNT FOR COMMON GROUNDWhat's Happening House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY) and Jared Kushner , the president's son-in-law and informal adviser, met privately in New York City, according to a New York Times report published Sunday. The two discussed housing, immigration, and cost of living as potential areas of common ground between House Democrats and the administration. Kushner reportedly suggested Jeffries meet with White House chief of staff Susie Wiles as a way to get the president's attention. The Situation The meeting space was arranged by a mutual friend; a source told the Times the two men were catching up. They previously worked together on criminal justice legislation during Trump's first term. Jeffries, in a statement to the Times: "In every conversation that we have with the Trump administration, we will continue to make it explicitly clear that the affordability crisis is not a hoax, and nothing short of transformational policy change is acceptable." Republicans hold narrow majorities in both chambers. If Democrats retake the House in November, Jeffries would be first in line to replace Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA). Caveat: the underlying account comes from the Times citing sources familiar with the meeting. Beyond Jeffries's written statement, neither man has publicly described what was said. The PerspectiveTwo people who disagree about most things sitting down to find the few things they don't is how a legislature is supposed to work, and the First Step Act is proof it can produce something. The interesting detail is not that they met — it's the agenda. Housing, immigration, and the cost of living are the three items voters keep naming, and both sides evidently know it. Republicans should not read that as a trap. If the GOP has the better answer on prices, it should want the argument out in the open, not conducted through press releases. Talking is not surrender; it is the only way anything reaches a president's desk. The MilitaryNAVY WEIGHS RENAMING THE CARRIER HONORING PEARL HARBOR HERO DORIS MILLERWhat's Happening Navy leadership has discussed renaming an aircraft carrier now under construction — designated the USS Doris Miller — after President Trump, two U.S. officials told NBC News. Those officials said the discussion has been ongoing for several months. Ship-naming authority rests with the Navy secretary, though defense secretaries are typically closely involved in carrier decisions — meaning the call would fall to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao. The Situation Doris Miller was a mess attendant at Pearl Harbor who manned an anti-aircraft gun he had never been trained on, is credited with downing at least one Japanese aircraft, and pulled wounded sailors to safety. He became the first Black service member awarded the Navy Cross , the Navy's second-highest decoration. The carrier was named for Miller during Trump's first term; it would be the first carrier named for a Black American and for an enlisted sailor. Caveat: no decision has been announced**. The reporting rests on two unnamed officials, and NBC News said the Navy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The PerspectiveNothing has been decided, and it should stay that way. Doris Miller is not a diversity gesture — he is a mess attendant who ran toward gunfire, worked a weapon nobody had let him train on, and carried wounded men out of the fire on a morning when the country needed exactly that. Honoring him is not identity politics; it is the oldest conservative instinct there is, which is that valor outranks rank. This administration named that ship for him, and that was a good decision then and now. There is also a plain republican case, small "r," against putting a living politician's name on a warship at all — a tradition both parties have chipped away at and both parties should restore. Let the ship be the Doris Miller. | ⚡ The Bottom LineToday's news is a lesson in what leverage actually costs. Washington is preparing to squeeze Tehran without firing a shot, and Tehran is threatening the shipping lane that sets the price of a gallon of gas. Ottawa was supposed to fold and instead matched us dollar for dollar. And in a quiet room in New York, the two parties' most pragmatic operators were talking about housing and grocery bills, because that is what everybody already knows the November argument is about. Strength abroad is worth having. So is an honest accounting of who pays for it. That's just the truth. "The truth isn't conservative or liberal. Someone else, somewhere else, is making decisions about your life—and you don’t get a say in it. Private equity firms. Tech executives. Bureaucrats You’ll never meet these people. But they shape our day, our family, our town. And nobody asks us. We feel it first in what things cost—insurance that runs more than a car payment, child care, groceries, a place to live. Everything costs more, and people are squeezed from every side. Costs must come down. But that’s just part of the story. The real issue is that so much of this is out of our hands. That’s what I’m fighting for in Congress—to claw back power into the hands of regular people and local towns. That’s why I fought for Right to Repair, so you’re not throwing out a washing machine every two years to buy another one. That’s why I fought for the Build Now Act to make it easier for young people to build up a good life right where they grew up. That’s why I fought to protect generational farms, so we’re not taxing people for passing farms onto their kids. OPINION:
# **Democratic Socialists are the ‘Abolish America’ party**

_by Leslie Rutledge Special to the[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette](https://us.list-manage.com/9hcN4PN3hZH?e=624a44d946&c2id=f3183fbb44b13f86f374b3da2b3069f5)_
---
| The co-chair of the Democratic Socialists of America was on a network interview, being walked through her organization's platform one item at a time. Abolish ICE? "Absolutely." Abolish the borders and grant amnesty to everyone here illegally? "Yep." Abolish prisons? "Yep." Abolish the United States Senate? "True."

She never hesitated. Not once. Replace the presidency and the Supreme Court as we know them? "Yep." Defund the Pentagon? "Absolutely." Public ownership of most large corporations? "Yeah, absolutely."

My husband and I were equally shocked by this interview.

"Wait. What?"

"These people want to do what with the United States of America?"

"Are you kidding me?"

As often happens in our household, after we catch up on his exhausting 12-hour day working in this heat trying to turn a profit in a tough year for soybeans, we talk current events, and our conversation centered on what kind of miserable country our 8-year-old daughter would inherit if people like the Democratic Socialists ever took power. Finally, as though the interview had been more exhausting than the day he'd just finished, he sighed, shook his head, and said, "Well, they might as well abolish America."

He nailed it.

Call me "old school." I am a bicentennial baby, born the summer this country turned 200 years old, and in the years since, I have watched things nobody serious would say out loud become planks in a party platform.

They did not get there overnight.

It started with the prisons. Twenty years ago, abolishing them was a seminar argument nobody outside a university took seriously. Then the police. Then immigration enforcement. Then the border altogether. Now the Senate, the presidency, the Supreme Court, and private ownership of the companies which employ our neighbors.

Every one of those was unthinkable until the one before it made it thinkable. Put them together, and the party carrying them has a name: the Abolish America Party.

I have enforced the law for much of my career. I still cannot believe we have reached the point where protecting society from dangerous criminals is treated as a debatable issue, or the very idea of having police is seen as arguable. As Arkansas' former attorney general, and as a prosecutor before that, I can tell you why prisons and police exist. Every decent society must answer the question of how to deal with the person who decides to cause harm. Six years ago, The New York Times published a column titled "Yes, We Mean Literally Abolish the Police." Not reform. Abolish. When deep-blue Minneapolis voters rejected that idea 56-44 percent, the Abolish America Party kept the plank anyway.

A country that will not protect the innocent from evil has already stopped being a country. A country that cannot control who enters is not in charge of itself.

And then comes the Senate. That one is aimed at every smaller state in the Union. Equal representation in the Senate is the bargain that made the United States possible. The promise that California does not get to decide everything for Arkansas, or Wyoming, or West Virginia. Strip it away, and the country becomes a handful of big coastal cities determining everything for everyone else. They can call that democracy. The rest of us know better.

This is not just the fringe of the Democratic Party, and it is not limited to big coastal cities. More than 30 socialist candidates have already won Democratic primaries this cycle. In June, Democratic Socialists Claire Valdez and Darializa Avila Chevalier won congressional primaries in New York. Avila Chevalier defeated a five-term Democratic incumbent. And just recently, in Florida of all places, Democratic Socialist state Rep. Angie Nixon won the Democratic Senate primary in an upset over rival Alex Vindman.

They would have us believe that the greatest nation in human history is nothing more than a crime scene. Democratic Party leaders have said almost nothing. There's a word for that sort of silence: Assent.

America remains the greatest experiment in ordered liberty the world has ever known, and we are not going to be the ones who hand her over to madness and chaos. We will not sit silently and let the Abolish America Party win.

We will stand and fight for God. The God of our fathers, the author of liberty, the one whose law is higher than any party platform or court decision. We will fight for our country. It was built with sweat and secured with sacrifice. Our ancestors established borders that mean something. They wrote laws that protect the weak. They handed America to us intact, and we will not let it be dismantled.

We will fight for our freedoms. The freedom to speak the truth, to worship without apology, and to raise our children the way we see fit. Government did not give us these freedoms, and government does not get to take them away, no matter how "antiquated" the left has decided the Constitution is.

This November is not a normal midterm. The radical Democrats have told us exactly what they intend to do. The only question left is whether the rest of us will let them abolish America.

_Leslie Rutledge serves as the lieutenant governor of Arkansas. She previously served as the 56th attorney general of Arkansas from 2015 to 2023._

I’m teaming up with the Democratic National Committee to bring a grassroots supporter like _you_ to Washington, DC for a personal tour of one of my very favorite spots here — the Air and Space Museum.

Your support of the DNC means that you want to make the world a better place, for all of us. It would mean so much to me to thank you in person.

name: Molly Gray
subject: New Labor Endorsement!
body:
Dear Peter, I’m proud to share that the Vermont Building and Construction Trades Council has endorsed our campaign for Lt. Governor today. This endorsement means a great deal to me. Vermont’s union building and construction workers are the people building our homes, schools, roads, and communities. They deserve a Lt. Governor who will stand with them. As Matt Glavin, President of the Vermont Building and Construction Trades Council, said:
He’s right: Vermont’s housing crisis won’t be solved without the skilled trades. We need to build more homes, invest in our infrastructure, and make sure the jobs that come with that work are good-paying union jobs that allow Vermonters to build a future here. I’m grateful to the Council, which consists of more than 15 Vermont unions, for their support and I’m ready to be a strong partner to organized labor as Lt. Governor.
But the fight for Vermont workers and their families can’t wait. **[Will you join me in pledging to vote “YES” this November on Proposal 3, an amendment to our Vermont Constitution to enshrine right to organize and form a union? ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137843161/642128527/-2097155937?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MjFlZjg2Ni1mYTlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VxcelDyvN7Vt7Xa9J8cYQMkNTaw40mp8_b_F9OCF9is=&emci=0acf6921-f99f-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=621ef866-fa9f-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=43402276)** Let’s win this! _Molly Gray_ | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137843162/642128528/679520187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MjFlZjg2Ni1mYTlmLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VxcelDyvN7Vt7Xa9J8cYQMkNTaw40mp8_b_F9OCF9is=)

body:
And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=351efcc5f2d34ab0bf7c843145eaeac4&_e=3uU1hqsrZSqaAuPb9d4qRR0W9ErQRkXBMyLOzCWgmq4JQxF7mxeM_Wzq8ysfmHTcN2GqmiWZLe2yDaX4YxAneKnsEA9ddS02CPVj8lC0K_-9TKITcVM82J043gfbAGcwuDBJdwzgyYqOqZYYM0A0ZZrZIwv5ejlhvZ7Rf4a-dji_KrtheWR2rC0e_TXeqvY3tgQvc3LZizoOpkZT6t92YmEhTLevgZdnudSI3R1Rg9_elFo2foCojQesh2y1ISqH572UT0zZfmSDCrqo7S2ACoRqpkoPoh_yl19JOWKhlptCVM4pl5VjuyjSdwddQBpgPJnV6ywDY_jJTPjq6q50hUyQ6u-rdbBcLk8_CXl452occZZ3Fn0NAbwmuZ8ahzyhXG8xGq6C8kmcVzh9qkzCDRyhxKpYZNcHx5k-HJPeIH451HXPiOdyH1BxTdFUKJSPqpFH8SgkSHfZPhtVajAB-BE4SIs3b5QbV4XcVI0mOFlGpjeBzgHTZfaYx5JaMWNKXCbIOtALSuQ8iFNQTUiiAISv_bcVXQxHKCXFKK8QRQOsMyvyChxPV90ziXr4Fm-YMDssK7h7mWF7is--DMjPq1EG3ysmwVpWSMou6uFi0PbqUWGwbDN1pVW3q8rF0UPlsiIj5xg8qQ5gLFOpv-EwSOM9csRqDg9gp9d7Y8GLn2hsqPrqmryhsVU0ZeDbqCI2)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=351efcc5f2d34ab0bf7c843145eaeac4&_e=3uU1hqsrZSqaAuPb9d4qRR0W9ErQRkXBMyLOzCWgmq4JQxF7mxeM_Wzq8ysfmHTcN2GqmiWZLe2yDaX4YxAneKnsEA9ddS02CPVj8lC0K_-9TKITcVM82J043gfbAGcwuDBJdwzgyYqOqZYYM0A0ZZrZIwv5ejlhvZ7Rf4a-dji_KrtheWR2rC0e_TXeqvY3tgQvc3LZizoOpkZT6t92YmEhTLevgZdnudSI3R1Rg98sAwXPuN7x00iFg8ZQt2bFrPpOId8sd-Lv5SFGbMPUvOLhIN2eGe4NXA3cFYoZ_2nL6soN_Oi9A2SPsRIq6_WmzFcEv9AEVm9HKBf-S3mnmc-ez66ahUWiDF2bVuvjEePK1K5YGYS1RaMhKx_n9tsdezh9f_LCD04k1cCT6c_oFFH168e1jXA9Uhmg8AhWc8bPm5U0DxaJRTvcRWui8_5ZiDTBEEUKeNnYiQ_2Y3Xa8htBDYLFrVWfei6CutxIV3NY8Htdvru7hiBCscTuw9_cWK4oLH42ofQS-rZR88DPoxXJ_Dx0ycomu8DJJqGss2o-d0lFECqOPKGRGLljRIXWAejULCvENfAWcTkutynmxpGy3iHV9qFzBvy5IH-B0RX5KMpu-ijJqEEWxRCwOyRUlEWdXhAVala4xhpsh-97XE3tdbLR5tSlJG3DlPZM77PPuYYjqbJGINfq28UihqEW)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. **And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.**But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=351efcc5f2d34ab0bf7c843145eaeac4&_e=3uU1hqsrZSqaAuPb9d4qRR0W9ErQRkXBMyLOzCWgmq4JQxF7mxeM_Wzq8ysfmHTcN2GqmiWZLe2yDaX4YxAneKnsEA9ddS02CPVj8lC0K_-9TKITcVM82J043gfbAGcwuDBJdwzgyYqOqZYYM0A0ZZrZIwv5ejlhvZ7Rf4a-dji_KrtheWR2rC0e_TXeqvY3tgQvc3LZizoOpkZT6t92YmEhTLevgZdnudSI3R1Rg99BLzO4awmpWVPKo0puso6AIzN6fh5qh20sDeV4cul9qOqHjHQTljp03AYa11MSHXX0PZmilH1bvlZEYHqR-ukrarHE0noc58REHNg8RfSH94n84Lv4udUutcanFOuzRgPPXgOaVy7O3Wgv-wl3cLeSWsCZYGM2NLotwtMDl1trKD6sQ3Va-SimNRXRX8j5iawKHmK3qPcUIbOGuN7vKZcgbfRsuan87kyJgkl0Wq-Rn6K-nmvtC-ImD-fFdV9uopOSRbwlfaaoY5L0WE0_mNts-UNrz02nYcWBiGi-sbyaWlLFoBxLV8ukDB7Qjo8zMnfKQJn1bIamBJyn6od6bivkaT5oUVkQp7pIbH5ts1rH5Kw5pog1Bm52IwDgBrXPZHt6XgqRvZf-hGlaLre7-2VJUdQom-CLgV-G3kHVDeFsK4HRouxZ3Yrl2w5I2pcs_ST8XjQeUlXEYDBmsxLDkX5L) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.**Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.**And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=753%2E127862%2EYp0U5e)
Let’s talk about data centers.
Under MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo, more than 70 data centers have moved into Nevada. Together, they’ve cashed in:
* Data centers have received $200 million of _your_ tax dollars.

* Lombardo's taken over $2 _million_ in campaign contributions from those same companies.

* Meanwhile, Nevada families are the ones left _holding the bag_ — facing higher electricity bills, drained water supplies, and jobs that were promised but never delivered.

Lombardo calls this a "model." **I call it a scam.**
I just wrapped my second statewide tour — Reno, Mesquite, Elko, Boulder City, Douglas, Carson City, Pahrump — and everywhere I went, I heard the same thing: folks are scared about what these data centers are doing to their bills, their water, and their neighborhoods.
**That’s why when I'm governor, the gravy train stops.**
I’m going to implement some of the strictest rules in America: data centers will need to bring their own water or coolant, pay for their own electricity, and actually deliver the sustainable high-paying jobs and tax revenue they’ve promised.
But before any of that happens, we have to win this toss-up race in November.

custom_fields.mailing_source_code %}&amounts=amounts) Peter, it’s been one year since we launched this Senate campaign here in Ohio.

I had never planned to run for office again, but when I saw what was happening in Washington, I knew I couldn’t sit this one out.

Washington politicians like my opponent, Republican Jon Husted, are raising prices for working families, gutting health care to pass tax breaks for billionaires, and giving sweetheart deals to corporations building data centers in your backyard.

I know we can defeat Husted and put working people first, but none of this is possible without grassroots support from people like you, so please: [**Will you split $20 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help us make this our biggest small-dollar fundraising day yet and ensure we have the resources to win in Ohio and take back the Senate?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14570?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.08.24_Brown-1-year_B3B_F1_S2_C1_180AC-365DON_T2&t=4&akid=2909%2E259176%2Ewj0jlK) I’m proud of everything we’ve accomplished together in fighting for working people – from protecting pensions to lowering drug prices to holding Wall Street accountable. But right now, Jon Husted isn’t willing to keep up this fight, and hardworking Ohioans are paying the price.

**We can build a future where all of us thrive, not just those with major stock portfolios, but it’s going to take a massive grassroots movement full of dedicated folks like you. That’s why I have to ask:** [**Will you split a donation between me and Blue Amp Action today? Senate control is at stake in this race, and I need the resources to fight back against the GOP’s dark money and win.**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14570?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.08.24_Brown-1-year_B3B_F1_S2_C1_180AC-365DON_T2&t=5&akid=2909%2E259176%2Ewj0jlK) I love Ohio, and I love this country. And when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.

In solidarity,

Sherrod Brown

subject: Judicial Watch: Federal Court Orders Justice Department to Answer Records Questions on FBI ‘Burn Bag Room’ Documents
body:
Judicial Watch announced that a federal judge ordered the U.S. Department of Justice to provide answers about nearly 2 million pages of FBI records discovered in a “hidden room” at FBI headquarters, including whether the records have already been reviewed in response to other Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests and whether the newly uncovered records had been stored in other government record systems:

_Formerly All On The Line_

Peter,
With the midterms only 71 days away, we’re doing everything we can to get voters to the polls. That is why our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, is partnering with VoteRiders to host a voter ID text bank targeting voters in Georgia and Texas. [**Join them tomorrow, August 24th, at 7 PM ET to help let voters know what they need in order to cast their ballots.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137843678/642130378/-553094416?utm_campaign=eng_aotl_tier1_email_GA&TXTextBankPromo_email_20260824-AOTL-Actives-GA&TXTextBankPromo_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=eng&utm_content=20260824-AOTL-Actives-GA&TXTextBankPromo_&utm_campaign=GA&TXTextBankPromo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA2MzYyNjZmLWZjOWYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Hmx9seCh_M--isyrPHHFrf4X1l0E7B9agyoy9yWVpjM=&emci=c66d68bf-e99f-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=0636266f-fc9f-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=8431045)

clean_body: Help us get voters informed and to the polls! | Formerly All On The Line Peter, With the midterms only 71 days away, we’re doing everything we can to get voters to the polls. That is why our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, is partnering with VoteRiders to host a voter ID text bank targeting voters in Georgia and Texas. With anti-democracy politicians deliberately trying to discourage voters from participating in our elections, it can be confusing to understand whether you need an ID to vote and what kind of ID is accepted. When voters have the ID information they need, they are empowered to vote with confidence. VoteRiders educates voters nationally with trusted, reliable information through strategic partnerships, on-the-ground organizing and outreach. With highly contested elections in both Georgia and Texas, informing the public of these requirements upholds the integrity of our political process. Help us ensure that every voter is able to exercise their rights, so that these elections are decided by the will of the people, and not by the shady machinations of entrenched politicians. Friend,

Before Ben Franklin helped write the Declaration of Independence, before he represented a new nation in the courts of Europe, he was something simpler and, in some ways, more remarkable.

He was an inventor.
* The lightning rod.
* The bifocal lens.
* A stove that heated homes more efficiently than anything before it.
* And many more everyday items!

Franklin never patented a single one of these creations, because he believed the whole point of a good idea was to share it with the world.

That single instinct, that a person with curiosity and grit could improve the lives of total strangers, made him the first American to become a celebrity for what he created rather than the title he held.
_**Benjamin Franklin wasn 't a statesman who happened to invent things on the side. He was, at his core, an entrepreneur. Someone who saw a problem, risked his time and reputation on a solution, and put it into the world without waiting for permission.**_
Since Franklin, our country has been carried forward by entrepreneurs who looked at a problem and decided they were the ones to solve it. Thomas Edison bet everything on an idea most people thought was impossible. Henry Ford risked his name on a vision for how ordinary families would live and move.

A generation later, entrepreneurs launching rockets, writing software, and reimagining the car are chasing that same instinct, the belief that if you see the future clearly enough, you can go out and make it.

This is the story **Hall of Giants** exists to tell, and it's a story we believe America has stopped telling well.

_Even worse, some exhibits, like the one currently at the Smithsonian, have leaned toward reducing entrepreneurs like Benjamin Franklin to a list of flaws._

Instead of static exhibits and placards, visitors step directly into the moments when someone decided to bet on themselves. They walk into the garage, where an idea first took shape. They stand on the factory floor where a risk finally paid off. They ride all the way to the bell at the Nasdaq, tracing the full arc of what it actually takes to go from an idea nobody believed in to a legacy that outlives its founder.

Every exhibit is designed to be lived in and argued with, not just looked at.

Visitors don't just look at him. They talk to him. They ask him about his inventions, his role in the Founding, and the ideas that made him a household name in his own lifetime. But they don't stop there. They ask him about his views on slavery, on women's suffrage, on the political flashpoints of his era, and they listen closely to how he answers.

What we've noticed is something we think says a lot about the country right now. The average American standing in front of that hologram doesn't fall into uncritical admiration, nor into knee-jerk vilification. They hold his whole life in their hands at once, the genius and the contradictions together, and they come away with a fuller, more honest picture of the man.

**That instinct, to look clearly at a real, complicated person and still find something worth celebrating, is exactly the instinct Hall of Giants wants to encourage.**
