name: Roy Cooper
subject: Following up on the petition my team sent over the weekend.
body:
Since we’re still about 3,200 responses short of our goal, I decided to extend the deadline until 11:59 p.m. tonight.
|
#
| | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&amount=5&t=9&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP) | Hey, Peter. Roy here, following up on the petition I sent a couple days ago. I’ve added it below just in case you missed it.
---
Since we’re still about 3,200 responses short of our goal, I decided to extend the deadline until 11:59 p.m. tonight.
Now that we’re less than 80 days out from the election, we have to kick our efforts into high gear – but it won’t make a difference if those efforts aren’t supported by folks on the ground, like you. So if you didn’t get a chance to add your name to endorse my campaign, I hope you’ll take a few minutes now to chime in.
Here’s that link again: [**_https:/act.roycooper.com/endorse-roy-cooper_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
Thanks in advance, Peter.

Roy Cooper
| | Peter, I’m not asking for your money. Let me explain.
---
President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and attacked me online. Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. GOP dark-money groups are spending millions to run ads statewide with baseless lies about my record.
**Simply put, I can’t win this race without people like you on my side.**
---
So all I’m asking is that you be one of the 30,000 folks l need to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina today. [_**Will you take 30 seconds now to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=11&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
---
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=12&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
---
I have spent my life trying to do right by the people of North Carolina.
---
Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.
---
**I’m running to take this critical work to Washington DC – but right now, the GOP is spending more in North Carolina than any other battleground state this cycle to defeat me.**
---
I know we have what it takes to flip this seat for the first time since 2008, but the only way it happens is if thousands of people like you stand with me in this fight.
---
**[So if you’re ready to win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and prevent two more years of unchecked Republican rule, will you endorse my grassroots campaign today?](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=13&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)**
---
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=14&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
---
I really appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
---
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&source=&t=1&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**[Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&source=&t=2&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1153_v2&source=&t=3&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
---

---

Cooper Victory Fund
PO Box 1190
Raleigh, NC 27602
Paid for by Cooper Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Cooper for North Carolina, DSCC, and North Carolina Democratic Party – Federal.
---
Contributions or gifts to Cooper Victory Fund are not tax deductible.
The first $7,000 of each contribution from a person and the first $10,000 from a multicandidate committee (“PAC”) will be allocated to Cooper for North Carolina. The first $3,500 of a person’s contribution and the first $5,000 of a PAC’s contribution will be designated for the primary election; the next $3,500/$5,000 will be designated for the general election. The next $10,000 from a person and $5,000 from a PAC will be allocated to North Carolina Democratic Party – Federal. The next $44,300 of a contribution from a person and the next $15,000 from a PAC will be allocated to the DSCC General Fund. The next $132,900 from a person and the next $45,000 from a PAC will be allocated to the DSCC Headquarters Fund. The next $132,900 from a person and the next $45,000 from a PAC will be allocated to the DSCC Legal Fund. A contributor may designate his or her contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if following it would result in an excessive contribution.
Any donor history information in this email reflects what we have on file for this specific email address. If you have donated with a different email address, with a check, or with a spouse — thank you so much! We have that on file and cannot thank you enough for supporting this campaign.
By clicking the links above, you certify that you are responsible for paying all charges incurred in using the debit or credit card to be charged, and that your personal funds will be the true source of the contribution.
If you wish to receive fewer messages from us, [submit this form to let us know.](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/i-want-less-emails-cooper-north-carolina/?t=15&akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)

[You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time.](http://act.roycooper.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2923%2E124072%2EgMTrRP)
